text: An approval mark as described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every rear combination lamp ESA conforming to a type approved under UN Regulation No. 10; no such marking is required if the lamp's electrical/electronic system is built into a vehicle approved as a unit.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as an ESA (housing / outer lens marking area; LED modules on PCB)
test_case: Visual inspection of production samples of the ESA-approved lamp: verify an approval mark per paragraph 5.3. is affixed. Pass if the mark is present on every unit; not applicable if the lamp is approved only as part of a vehicle type.

text: The rear combination lamp ESA and its electrical/electronic system(s), including its LED light sources, PCB and electrical connections, shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of UN Regulation No. 10.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electronics (LED modules on PCB, connector/harness interface) as an ESA
test_case: Design review of the EMC design, filtering and layout, plus successful completion of all applicable UN R10 ESA tests (radiated and conducted emissions, radiated and conducted immunity). Pass if all limits and immunity criteria are met with the lamp in representative normal operating modes (rear position, stop and reversing functions on).

text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for radiated emissions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED light sources for rear position, stop and reversing functions on PCB)
test_case: UN R10 Annex 7 (broadband) and Annex 8 (narrowband) ESA radiated emission methods, with each lamp function energised at nominal supply. Pass if the emissions stay below the ESA reference limits of R10 paragraphs 6.5 and 6.6.

text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for conducted emissions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA power supply lines / connector
test_case: UN R10 Annex 10 method for transient conducted emissions on the supply lines, with lamp functions switched on and off. Pass if the transient amplitudes stay within the limits of R10 paragraph 6.8.

text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (stop, rear position and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: UN R10 Annex 9 ESA radiated immunity methods at the field strengths of R10 paragraph 6.7, with functions monitored per the test plan. Pass if there is no degradation of the stop, rear position or reversing lamp functions, e.g. no unintended switching, flicker or loss of light output beyond the defined criteria.

text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for immunity to conducted disturbances.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA power supply lines / connector
test_case: UN R10 Annex 10 conducted transient immunity test pulses on the supply lines, at the test levels of R10 paragraph 6.9. Pass if the functional status criteria are met and the lamp functions are not impaired.

text: The broadband electromagnetic radiation generated by the rear combination lamp ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector, drive electronics)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement on a representative ESA sample with all lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) operating; verify the test report shows the Annex 7 method was applied.

text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission test, 30-75 MHz, peak detector per Annex 7; pass if all measured values are below the log-decreasing limit line from 62 dBµV/m at 30 MHz to 52 dBµV/m at 75 MHz (Appendix 6).

text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission test, 75-400 MHz; pass if all measured values are below the log-increasing limit line from 52 dBµV/m at 75 MHz to 63 dBµV/m at 400 MHz (Appendix 6).

text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission test, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if all measured values are below 63 dBµV/m.

text: On the rear combination lamp ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector)
test_case: Compare Annex 7 broadband results across 30-1,000 MHz for each operating lamp function with the paragraph 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if every measured value is below the limit (no margin exceedance).

text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation generated by the rear combination lamp ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, driver electronics, connector)
test_case: Annex 8 ESA radiated emission test; confirm the test report states Annex 8 narrowband method was used on a representative sample.

text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband measurement, 30-75 MHz; pass if measured level is below the limit line decreasing logarithmically from 52 dB µV/m at 30 MHz to 42 dB µV/m at 75 MHz (Appendix 7).

text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband measurement, 75-400 MHz; pass if measured level is below the limit line increasing logarithmically from 42 dB µV/m at 75 MHz to 53 dB µV/m at 400 MHz (Appendix 7).

text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband measurement, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if measured level is below 53 dB µV/m across the band.

text: On the rear combination lamp ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (all lamp functions: rear position, stop, reversing)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband measurement over 30-1,000 MHz with each function operating; pass if all measured values are below the limits of paragraph 6.6.2.1.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances on the 12/24 V supply lines of the rear combination lamp, as an ESA representative of its type, shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector to vehicle supply lines)
test_case: Conduct transient emission testing per ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 on the supply lines of a representative sample; record the positive and negative pulse amplitudes and compare them with the Table 1 limits.

text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the positive transient pulse amplitude conducted by the rear combination lamp onto the supply lines shall not exceed +75 V.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA on 12 V supply (LED drivers/PCB, connector)
test_case: Perform the ISO 7637-2 test per Annex 10 with a 12 V supply. Pass if the measured maximum positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +75 V.

text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the negative transient pulse amplitude conducted by the rear combination lamp onto the supply lines shall not exceed -100 V.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA on 12 V supply (LED drivers/PCB, connector)
test_case: Perform the ISO 7637-2 test per Annex 10 with a 12 V supply. Pass if the measured maximum negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -100 V in magnitude.

text: For vehicles with 24 V systems, the positive transient pulse amplitude conducted by the rear combination lamp onto the supply lines shall not exceed +150 V.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA on 24 V supply (LED drivers/PCB, connector)
test_case: Perform the ISO 7637-2 test per Annex 10 with a 24 V supply, if a 24 V variant applies. Pass if the measured maximum positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +150 V.

text: For vehicles with 24 V systems, the negative transient pulse amplitude conducted by the rear combination lamp onto the supply lines shall not exceed -450 V.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA on 24 V supply (LED drivers/PCB, connector)
test_case: Perform the ISO 7637-2 test per Annex 10 with a 24 V supply, if a 24 V variant applies. Pass if the measured maximum negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -450 V in magnitude.

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector) – all lighting functions
test_case: Annex 9: test the lamp with one or more of the stripline, TEM cell, BCI, ALSE or reverberation chamber methods. Pass if the chosen method(s) are documented and applied to a representative sample.

text: When tested by the stripline method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 stripline, 20 to 400 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation of the immunity related functions at 60 V/m over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

text: When tested by the stripline method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 stripline, 20 to 400 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation of the immunity related functions at 50 V/m at all frequencies.

text: When tested by the TEM cell method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell, 20 to 200 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 75 V/m over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

text: When tested by the TEM cell method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell, 20 to 200 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 62,5 V/m at all frequencies.

text: When tested by the bulk current injection (BCI) method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA, wiring harness connection/connector
test_case: Annex 9 BCI on the harness, 20 to 400 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 60 mA over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

text: When tested by the bulk current injection (BCI) method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA, wiring harness connection/connector
test_case: Annex 9 BCI, 20 to 400 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 50 mA at all frequencies.

text: When tested by the ALSE method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 30 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 80 to 2,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 30 V/m over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

text: When tested by the ALSE method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 10 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 10 V/m over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

text: When tested by the ALSE method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 25 V/m over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 80 to 2,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 25 V/m at all frequencies.

text: When tested by the ALSE method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 8 V/m at all frequencies.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 21 V/m in over 90 per cent of the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, LUF to 2,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 21 V/m over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 7 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 7 V/m over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 18 V/m over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, LUF to 2,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 18 V/m at all frequencies.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 6 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED electronics/PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 6 V/m at all frequencies.

text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of the immunity related functions of the ESA.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions (LED modules and PCB)
test_case: Annex 9 at the Table 2a/2b levels. Monitor each lamp function for unintended switching on or off, flicker and loss of light output. Pass if no deviation from normal operation is observed.

text: The immunity of the ESA representative of this type to transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector to vehicle supply)
test_case: Annex 10 conducted transient tests on supply lines per ISO 16750-2 (starting profile) and ISO 7637-2 (pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b) at the Table 3a/3b levels; pass if the functional status/FPSC required for each pulse is met.

text: The starting profile test of the ESA shall be evaluated according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (all lamp functions)
test_case: Annex 10 starting profile test per ISO 16750-2; classify the observed lamp behaviour per ISO 16750-1 functional status; pass if the Table 3a status is reached.

text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied to the ESA for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (all lamp functions)
test_case: Annex 10 ISO 7637-2 pulse tests; classify lamp behaviour per ISO 7637-1 FPSC; pass if the Table 3b FPSC is reached for each pulse.

text: If the ESA could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12V/24V starter motor, the ESA shall withstand the starting profile at immunity test level II (12 V and 24 V systems) with 10 pulses, achieving functional status B for immunity related functions where the ESA shall be operational during engine start phases, status C for other ESA, and status D for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Stop lamp, rear position lamp and reversing lamp electronics (LED drivers on PCB)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II, 10 pulses, lamps operating; pass if functional status per ISO 16750-1 is B (operational during start) or C (other) for immunity related functions, D for non-related functions.

text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V system) / -450 V (24 V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related and not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Stop lamp, rear position lamp and reversing lamp electronics (LED drivers on PCB)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 1, -75 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V), 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III per ISO 7637-1.

text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 2a at +37 V (12 V system) / +37 V (24 V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Stop lamp, rear position lamp and reversing lamp electronics (LED drivers on PCB)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a, +37 V, 500 pulses; pass if FPSC I (immunity related lamp functions, e.g. stop and position lamps) or FPSC III (non-related functions) per ISO 7637-1.

text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 2b at +10 V (12 V system) / +20 V (24 V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Stop lamp, rear position lamp and reversing lamp electronics (LED drivers on PCB)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b, +10 V (12 V) or +20 V (24 V), 10 pulses; pass if FPSC II (immunity related) or FPSC III (non-related) per ISO 7637-1.

text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V system) / -150 V (24 V system) for a test duration of 1 h with FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Stop lamp, rear position lamp and reversing lamp electronics (LED drivers on PCB)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a, -112 V (12 V) or -150 V (24 V), 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) or FPSC III (non-related) per ISO 7637-1.

text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V system) / +150 V (24 V system) for a test duration of 1 h with FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Stop lamp, rear position lamp and reversing lamp electronics (LED drivers on PCB)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b, +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V), 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) or FPSC III (non-related) per ISO 7637-1.

text: Where the rear combination lamp ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8 (narrowband radiated emissions).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Design review of the PCB schematic and BOM: confirm absence of any oscillator, clock or switching regulator operating above 9 kHz. If confirmed, the narrowband emission test per Annex 8 may be waived; otherwise test per paragraph 6.6.2./Annex 8.

text: Where the rear combination lamp ESA is not switched, contains no switches and does not include inductive load, it need not be tested for transient conducted emission on 12/24 V supply lines and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, electrical connector and supply line interface
test_case: Design review of the circuit: confirm no internal switches, no switching function and no inductive loads (e.g. coils, relays). If confirmed, the transient conducted emission test is waived; otherwise test per paragraph 6.7./Annex 10 on 12/24 V supply lines.

text: The conformity of production procedures for the rear combination lamp (as an ESA under UN R10) shall comply with those set out in Schedule 1 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), together with the additional requirements of paragraph 9 of UN R10.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electronics (LED modules on PCB, connector) – series production EMC conformity
test_case: Audit of the manufacturer's CoP procedures and records against Schedule 1 of E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3; perform R10 EMC tests on production samples and verify results conform to the approved type.

text: The rear combination lamp (ESA) approved under UN Regulation No. 10 shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7. of the Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as an ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector, overall electronic assembly)
test_case: Conformity of production check: sample production units and repeat the EMC tests of paragraph 6 (e.g. radiated broadband/narrowband emissions per Annexes 7 and 8, immunity per Annex 9) and, if applicable, paragraph 7 (conducted emissions and immunity tests); pass if production samples meet the same limits as the approved type.

text: Conformity of production of the rear combination lamp as an electrical/electronic sub-assembly (component or separate technical unit) shall be checked on the basis of the data contained in the communication form(s) for type approval set out in Annex 3A and/or 3B to UN R10.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electronics (LED modules on PCB, connector) as an ESA, in series production
test_case: Conformity of production check: compare series-production samples against the data in the type approval communication form (Annex 3A and/or 3B), e.g. drawings, part numbers, LED/PCB configuration and EMC performance. Pass if production units match the approved type data and still meet the R10 emission and immunity limits.

text: When the conformity of the rear combination lamp (ESA) taken from the series is being verified, the measured broadband electromagnetic disturbance levels shall not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.5.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, LED driver electronics, connector) – broadband emissions of series production
test_case: Conformity of production test on a series sample per the broadband ESA emission method referenced in para 6.5.2.1; pass if measured levels ≤ reference limits + 4 dB (60 per cent).

text: When the conformity of the rear combination lamp (ESA) taken from the series is being verified, the measured narrowband electromagnetic disturbance levels shall not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.6.2.1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, LED driver electronics, connector) – narrowband emissions of series production
test_case: Conformity of production test on a series sample per the narrowband ESA emission method referenced in para 6.6.2.1; pass if measured levels ≤ reference limits + 4 dB (60 per cent).

text: When the conformity of the rear combination lamp (ESA) taken from the series is being verified, the ESA shall not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA – immunity to electromagnetic radiation of rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions in series production
test_case: Conformity of production radiated immunity test on a series sample at field strengths up to 80 % of the para 6.8.2.1 reference limits; pass if no observable degradation of the lamp functions (e.g. no flicker, extinction or unintended activation).

text: When the conformity of the rear combination lamp taken from the series is being verified as a component or STU, the lamp shall show no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to the conducted disturbance levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA – immunity to conducted disturbances on supply lines (connector, PCB electronics)
test_case: Conformity of production conducted transient immunity test on a series sample at levels per para 6.9.1; pass if no degradation of performance of immunity related functions (stop, position, reversing lamp output).

text: When the conformity of the rear combination lamp taken from the series is being verified as a component or STU, the lamp shall not exceed the conducted emission levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA – conducted transient emissions on supply lines
test_case: Conformity of production conducted transient emission test on a series sample per para 6.7.1; pass if measured emission levels do not exceed the given levels.

text: When measured according to paragraph 6.5.2.1. (method of Annex 7) with a 120 kHz bandwidth, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m, where F is the frequency in MHz.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as ESA: LED modules on PCB and electrical connector (all lamp functions energised)
test_case: Broadband radiated emission test per Annex 7 (ALSE, antenna at 1 m), lamp operated in its emitting modes, 120 kHz measurement bandwidth, scan 30-75 MHz; pass if all measured values are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (62 dBµV/m at 30 MHz falling to 52 dBµV/m at 75 MHz).

text: When measured according to paragraph 6.5.2.1. (method of Annex 7) with a 120 kHz bandwidth, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m, where F is the frequency in MHz.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as ESA: LED modules on PCB and electrical connector (all lamp functions energised)
test_case: Broadband radiated emission test per Annex 7 (ALSE, antenna at 1 m), lamp operated in its emitting modes, 120 kHz measurement bandwidth, scan 75-400 MHz; pass if all measured values are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (52 dBµV/m at 75 MHz rising to 63 dBµV/m at 400 MHz).

text: When measured according to paragraph 6.5.2.1. (method of Annex 7) with a 120 kHz bandwidth, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the constant limit E = 63 dBµV/m.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as ESA: LED modules on PCB and electrical connector (all lamp functions energised)
test_case: Broadband radiated emission test per Annex 7 (ALSE, antenna at 1 m), lamp operated in its emitting modes, 120 kHz measurement bandwidth, scan 400-1,000 MHz; pass if all measured values are at or below 63 dBµV/m.

text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8 (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.), the narrowband radiated emission limit of the ESA in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m, F in MHz, for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and electrical connector of the rear combination lamp (electronic sub-assembly) during operation of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Annex 8 ESA narrowband radiated emission test with 120 kHz bandwidth, ESA operated in all lamp functions; pass if the measured narrowband level at every frequency from 30 to 75 MHz is at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8 (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.), the narrowband radiated emission limit of the ESA in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m, F in MHz, for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and electrical connector of the rear combination lamp (electronic sub-assembly) during operation of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Annex 8 ESA narrowband radiated emission test with 120 kHz bandwidth, ESA operated in all lamp functions; pass if the measured narrowband level at every frequency from 75 to 400 MHz is at or below 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8 (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.), the narrowband radiated emission limit of the ESA in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and electrical connector of the rear combination lamp (electronic sub-assembly) during operation of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Annex 8 ESA narrowband radiated emission test with 120 kHz bandwidth, ESA operated in all lamp functions; pass if the measured narrowband level at every frequency from 400 to 1,000 MHz is at or below 53 dBµV/m.

text: For the rear combination lamp as an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω artificial network (AN) as defined in Figure 1 of Appendix 8 shall be used for the EMC tests.
applies_to: Test setup for LV power supply lines of the rear combination lamp (PCB connector / wiring harness connection)
test_case: Inspect the test setup: confirm the AN on the lamp's LV supply lines is a 5 µH / 50 Ω network matching Figure 1 (L1 5 µH, C1 0,1 µF, C2 1 µF, R1 1 kΩ). Pass if the AN conforms.

text: The AN(s) used for the LV-powered rear combination lamp shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
applies_to: Test setup for LV power supply lines of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Inspect the test setup. Pass if each AN sits directly on the ground plane.

text: The grounding connection of the AN(s) used for the LV-powered rear combination lamp shall be bonded to the ground plane.
applies_to: Test setup for LV power supply lines of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Inspect the setup and check the bonding of the AN ground terminal to the ground plane. Pass if a bonded ground connection is present.

text: Measurement ports of the AN(s) used for the LV-powered rear combination lamp shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
applies_to: Test setup for LV power supply lines of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Inspect the AN measuring ports (MEP). Pass if each port is connected to the 50 Ω receiver or terminated with a 50 Ω load.

text: The AN impedance ZPB shall follow Figure 2 within a tolerance of ± 20 % in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz, measured between terminals P and B (of Figure 1) with a 50 Ω load on the measurement port and terminals A and B short circuited.
applies_to: Artificial network used for testing the rear combination lamp LV supply
test_case: Measure ZPB between P and B from 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz, with a 50 Ω load on the MEP and A–B short circuited. Pass if ZPB stays within ± 20 % of the Figure 2 characteristic.

text: Unless otherwise stated in Annex 7, the broadband electromagnetic emission test of the rear combination lamp ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
applies_to: Lamp electronics (LED modules on PCB, connector) as ESA
test_case: Annex 7 / CISPR 25 radiated broadband emission test; check the test report states CISPR 25 compliance.

text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp LED functions during EMC test
test_case: Annex 7 para 2.1: operate all lamp functions simultaneously at nominal supply voltage (maximum load); verify the operating state is recorded in the test report.

text: For an ESA not involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA
test_case: Test in an absorber lined shielded enclosure per CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 setup; verify the setup against the CISPR 25 figures.

text: Ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test, and the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
applies_to: EMC test of rear combination lamp (ambient check)
test_case: Measure with the ESA switched off over 30 to 1,000 MHz; pass if ambient is ≥6 dB below the para 6.5.2.1 broadband limits.

text: The broadband radiated emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA radiated broadband emissions
test_case: Sweep 30 to 1,000 MHz; pass if all readings are below the para 6.5 limits across the whole range.

text: If peak detectors are used for the broadband emission measurement, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the quasi-peak limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA emission evaluation
test_case: Check the evaluation uses limits adjusted by 20 dB when a peak detector is used; pass if peak readings are within the corrected limit.

text: The broadband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2 of Annex 7.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp EMC test instrumentation
test_case: Review the instrument settings in the test report against Tables 1 and 2.

text: When a spectrum analyser with a peak detector is used in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the RBW at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz and the minimum scan time shall be 100 ms/MHz.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp EMC test instrumentation
test_case: Verify the analyser settings: RBW 100/120 kHz, scan time ≥100 ms/MHz.

text: When a spectrum analyser with a quasi-peak detector is used in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the RBW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz and the minimum scan time shall be 20 s/MHz.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp EMC test instrumentation
test_case: Verify the analyser settings: RBW 120 kHz, scan time ≥20 s/MHz.

text: When a scanning receiver with a peak detector is used in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time 5 ms.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp EMC test instrumentation
test_case: Verify the receiver settings: BW 120 kHz, step ≤60 kHz, dwell ≥5 ms.

text: When a scanning receiver with a quasi-peak detector is used in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time 1 s.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp EMC test instrumentation
test_case: Verify the receiver settings: BW 120 kHz, step ≤60 kHz, dwell ≥1 s.

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp EMC test instrumentation
test_case: Verify that VBW ≥ 3 × RBW in the analyser settings.

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp EMC test instrumentation
test_case: Confirm the FFT instrument operates in real-time, gapless mode.

text: If FFT-based instruments are used, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp EMC test instrumentation
test_case: Verify a measurement time of ≥1 s per FFT analysis band.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp test harness (connector/vehicle wiring)
test_case: Inspect the setup: LV harness positioned on the antenna side.

text: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp EMC test setup
test_case: Measure the antenna alignment relative to the harness centre.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA emission evaluation
test_case: For any exceedance, repeat with the ESA off to confirm the source; record the investigation in the report.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA emission evaluation
test_case: Measure in both polarizations; take the worst-case reading per band and compare it with the limit; pass if all are below the limit.

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the radiated narrowband electromagnetic emission test of the rear combination lamp (ESA) shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electronics (LED modules on PCB, connector) as ESA
test_case: Annex 8 / CISPR 25 radiated narrowband emission test; verify that the test set-up and procedure follow CISPR 25 unless Annex 8 states otherwise.

text: During the narrowband emission test, the rear combination lamp (ESA) under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp operating state (rear position, stop and reversing LED functions)
test_case: Annex 8 para. 2; operate the lamp with the functions energised at nominal supply, preferably all functions on (maximum load); check that the test report records the operating mode.

text: The narrowband emission test of the rear combination lamp shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA test arrangement
test_case: CISPR 25 para. 6.4 ALSE set-up (ground plane, harness, antenna positions); verify conformity of the set-up.

text: If an open area test site (OATS) is used as an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), the OATS shall comply with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA test site
test_case: Check OATS validation against CISPR 16-1-4 (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7) before testing.

text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main narrowband emission test of the rear combination lamp.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA test environment
test_case: Perform ambient scan 30 to 1,000 MHz with the lamp de-energised before or after the main test; record results.

text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of the Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA test environment
test_case: Compare ambient scan with paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits; pass if ambient ≤ limit − 6 dB at all frequencies other than intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.

text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply to the rear combination lamp throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp radiated narrowband emissions
test_case: Scan 30 to 1,000 MHz in ALSE or OATS; pass if emissions are below paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits across the whole range.

text: The narrowband emission measurements of the rear combination lamp shall be performed with an average detector.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement
test_case: Verify measuring instrument detector setting is average for all readings.

text: The narrowband emission measurements of the rear combination lamp shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver, using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2 of Annex 8.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Check instrument type and settings against Annex 8 Tables 1 and 2.

text: When a spectrum analyser is used with the average detector in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the resolution bandwidth at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz and the minimum scan time shall be 100 ms/MHz.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Verify spectrum analyser settings: RBW (-3 dB) 100/120 kHz, scan time ≥ 100 ms/MHz.

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Verify VBW ≥ 3 × RBW in any peak measurement settings.

text: When a scanning receiver is used with the average detector in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the bandwidth at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size shall be 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time shall be 5 ms.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Verify receiver settings: BW (-6 dB) 120 kHz, step ≤ 60 kHz, dwell ≥ 5 ms.

text: Spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments used for conformity measurements shall meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Check instrument calibration/compliance certificate against CISPR 16-1-1.

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Verify FFT instrument operates in gapless real-time mode during measurement.

text: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Verify FFT measurement time ≥ 1 s per analysis frequency band in real-time mode.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test of the rear combination lamp, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement evaluation
test_case: On any limit exceedance, repeat with lamp de-energised and analyse signal character (narrowband vs broadband); record that exceedance is attributable to the lamp.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp emission measurement evaluation
test_case: Measure in horizontal and vertical antenna polarisation; for each of the 14 bands take the maximum reading relative to the limit as the characteristic reading; pass if below the limit.

text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested using any combination, at the manufacturer's discretion, of the absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5 or the reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11, provided that the results cover the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and connector (ESA as a whole)
test_case: Review test plan/reports: confirm that the selected ISO 11452 methods together cover 20 to 6,000 MHz without gaps.

text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the rear combination lamp ESA immunity test shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: ESA immunity test setup
test_case: Check that the test report references ISO 11452-1 for the frequency range and general conditions.

text: The test conditions for the rear combination lamp ESA immunity test shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: ESA immunity test setup
test_case: Audit the test setup (temperature, supply voltage, ground plane and similar conditions) against ISO 11452-1.

text: The rear combination lamp ESA under test shall be switched on and stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp LED functions
test_case: During immunity tests, energise the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions in normal operation and verify by monitoring that they remain active.

text: The rear combination lamp ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in Annex 9 unless the individual test methods dictate otherwise.
applies_to: ESA test arrangement
test_case: Inspect the arrangement against Annex 9 and the applicable ISO 11452 part.

text: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the rear combination lamp ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
applies_to: ESA test calibration
test_case: Verify from the calibration record that the ESA support equipment was absent during field/current calibration.

text: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
applies_to: ESA test calibration
test_case: Measure the distance from the reference point to any equipment during calibration; pass if it is at least 1 m.

text: The test signal generating equipment and its layout used for the rear combination lamp ESA test shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
applies_to: ESA test equipment
test_case: Compare the equipment list and layout of the test with the calibration records; they shall be identical.

text: Immunity measurements of the rear combination lamp ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: ESA immunity test
test_case: Sweep 20 to 6,000 MHz using ISO 11452-1 steps; no malfunction of the lamp functions is permitted.

text: In the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation) with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth.
applies_to: ESA immunity test signal
test_case: Verify the generator settings: AM, 1 kHz, 80 per cent depth over 20 to 400 MHz.

text: In the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2) with Ton 3 µs and period 3,333 µs.
applies_to: ESA immunity test signal
test_case: Verify the generator settings: PM, Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs over 2,700 to 3,100 MHz.

text: In the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3) with Ton 500 µs and period 1,000 µs.
applies_to: ESA immunity test signal
test_case: Verify the generator settings: PM, Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs over 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz.

text: The frequency step size and dwell time for the rear combination lamp ESA test shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: ESA immunity test
test_case: Check the step size and dwell time in the test report against ISO 11452-1.

text: If the rear combination lamp ESA fails the tests, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
applies_to: ESA immunity test evaluation
test_case: On failure, check the field/forward power monitoring to confirm that no uncontrolled fields were generated at the failure frequency.

text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the substitution method shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
applies_to: ESA absorber chamber test
test_case: ISO 11452-2 substitution method calibration record present and applied.

text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
applies_to: ESA absorber chamber test
test_case: Verify that the antenna orientation is vertical polarization in the test report.

text: When TEM cell testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
applies_to: ESA TEM cell test
test_case: Test per ISO 11452-3 within the applicable frequency range; lamp functions shall be unaffected.

text: When bulk current injection testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench, either with the substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or with the closed loop method and the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
applies_to: ESA wiring harness / connector (BCI test)
test_case: Verify that the probe distance is 150 mm (substitution) or 900 mm (closed loop) per ISO 11452-4.

text: As an alternative, the ESA may be tested installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 using the BCI substitution method with the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
applies_to: ESA installed in vehicle (BCI test)
test_case: If tested in-vehicle, verify ISO 11451-4 substitution method with the probe at 150 mm from the lamp.

text: When stripline testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
applies_to: ESA wiring harness (stripline test)
test_case: Test per ISO 11452-5; lamp functions shall be unaffected.

text: When the reverberation chamber test is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
applies_to: ESA reverberation chamber test
test_case: Test per ISO 11452-11; lamp functions shall be unaffected.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
applies_to: ESA reverberation chamber test
test_case: Inspect the setup for the presence of a ground plane.

text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be immune to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, PCB electronics and electrical connector (vehicle power supply interface)
test_case: Annex 10 method: apply ISO 7637-2 test pulses and ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply lines; the functional status of the lamp functions shall meet the ESA immunity criteria.

text: Conducted transients emitted by the rear combination lamp ESA to the vehicle power supply shall be limited.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, PCB electronics and electrical connector (vehicle power supply interface)
test_case: Annex 10 paragraph 3 method: measure per ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines; emissions shall stay within the applicable limits.

text: Test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the 12/24 V supply lines of the ESA, as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
applies_to: Electrical connector/terminal block and PCB supply inputs for the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: ISO 7637-2: apply pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to each supply line and each connection operationally linked to supply lines; check the lamp functions against the immunity functional status criteria.

text: The starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the 12/24 V supply lines of the ESA, as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, unless the ESA is exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor).
applies_to: Electrical connector/terminal block and PCB supply inputs for the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile applied to the supply lines and connected inputs; check the lamp functions against the immunity criteria. The lamp is for M1 vehicles generally, so the test applies.

text: Emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines, as well as on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
applies_to: Electrical connector/terminal block and PCB electronics (LED modules and drivers)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 conducted transient emission measurement on the supply lines and connected inputs during switching of the lamp functions; results shall be within the specified limits.

text: The rear combination lamp shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
applies_to: Housing / outer lens marking area
test_case: Drawing review and visual inspection of a production sample: a marking area is provided that accommodates the approval marking and all markings of paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

text: All markings on the rear combination lamp shall be clearly legible and indelible.
applies_to: All markings on lamp
test_case: Visual inspection for legibility; indelibility check (e.g. rubbing with water- and petrol-soaked cloth); markings remain legible.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval mark on the sample or drawing per Annex 7 arrangement: a >= 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection against approval documents: E-circle with correct country number present.

text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., placed close to the approval mark.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection: 4–6 digit sequential number matching the approval number is present and located close to the approval mark.

text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4. (rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp).
applies_to: Approval marking – rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Visual inspection: function symbols per paragraph 3.2.4. for each approved function are present.

text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection: "148R" followed by the correct two-digit series of amendments is present.

text: If the lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, it shall bear a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
applies_to: Left/right handed rear combination lamp – approval marking
test_case: Review of handedness of lamp design; visual inspection: horizontal arrow present on left- and right-hand variants.

text: For the rear position lamp, the horizontal mounting arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function – approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of lamp in mounted orientation: arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

text: In case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the horizontal mounting arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function – approval marking
test_case: If reversing lamp approved with reduced light distribution: visual inspection that arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

text: If the lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
applies_to: Approval marking – function symbols
test_case: If applicable per approval: visual inspection that "D" is to the right of the relevant function symbol.

text: If the lamp is used as part of an interdependent lamps system, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
applies_to: Approval marking – function symbols
test_case: If applicable per approval: visual inspection that "Y" is to the right of the relevant function symbol.

text: On lamps with reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
applies_to: Reversing lamp / rear position lamp with reduced light distribution – approval marking
test_case: If reduced light distribution per Annex 3 paragraph 1.1. is claimed: visual inspection that the downward vertical arrow from a horizontal segment is present.

text: The lamp shall bear the approval marking.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection of production sample: approval marking present.

text: The lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection: trade name or mark of applicant present on the lamp.

text: Since the lamp has non-replaceable light sources (LEDs), the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp with non-replaceable LED light sources
test_case: Visual inspection: rated voltage (e.g. 12V) or voltage range marked on the lamp, consistent with approval documents.

text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
applies_to: Housing / outer lens – marking location
test_case: Design review and inspection: marking is on a part permanently joined to the light-emitting outer lens.

text: The approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
applies_to: Approval marking – installation on M1 vehicle rear
test_case: Inspection of lamp fitted on vehicle (boot lid/tailgate opened if necessary): approval marking visible.

text: If the outer lens of the lamp is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
applies_to: Outer lens and housing
test_case: If lens is detachable by design: visual inspection that approval marking appears on both lens and housing.

text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
applies_to: Outer lens shared by several devices / housing
test_case: If applicable: inspection that each main body carries only the marking for its own functions.

text: The approval marking and the markings of paragraphs 3.3.3.2. and 3.3.3.4. (trade name or mark and rated voltage) shall be affixed on the lamp.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection: approval marking, trade name/mark and rated voltage are affixed on the lamp itself.

text: Where a single approval mark is used for the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, it shall be visible after their installation.
applies_to: Combined rear lamp – single approval mark
test_case: Inspection on vehicle: single approval mark visible after installation.

text: Where a single approval mark is used for the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
applies_to: Combined rear lamp – outer lens / single approval mark
test_case: Design review and disassembly check: no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
applies_to: Combined rear lamp – single approval mark
test_case: Measure mark components and compare with minimum sizes of each applicable regulation (e.g. R148, R150): no component smaller than the smallest required minimum.

text: The conformity of production procedures for the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector) shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the requirements set forth in paragraph 6.
applies_to: Whole rear combination lamp, all functions (production quality / conformity of production)
test_case: Audit of the manufacturer's conformity of production procedures and production test records against 1958 Agreement Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3) and paragraph 6 of UN R148. Pass if the procedures are documented and implemented, and if sampled production lamps meet the paragraph 6 requirements.

text: Each lamp of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp) submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5. of UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp: rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Compliance review against all requirements of paragraphs 4. and 5. of UN R148 (general and photometric/colorimetric requirements). Pass if every applicable requirement of paragraphs 4. and 5. is fulfilled for each lamp function.

text: The rear position lamp function shall comply with the requirements of sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and the Annexes referenced in those sections) of UN Regulation No. 48, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, that are pertinent to rear position lamps on M1 vehicles, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (geometric visibility, orientation, installation-related characteristics)
test_case: Review of lamp design and documentation against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 (e.g. geometric visibility angles, orientation) for M1, evaluated during lamp type approval; pass if all requirements verifiable at lamp level are met.

text: The stop lamp function shall comply with the requirements of sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and the Annexes referenced in those sections) of UN Regulation No. 48, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, that are pertinent to stop lamps on M1 vehicles, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (geometric visibility, orientation, installation-related characteristics)
test_case: Review of lamp design and documentation against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 for stop lamps on M1, evaluated during lamp type approval; pass if all requirements verifiable at lamp level are met.

text: The reversing lamp function shall comply with the requirements of sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and the Annexes referenced in those sections) of UN Regulation No. 48, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, that are pertinent to reversing lamps on M1 vehicles, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (geometric visibility incl. 45° outboard, orientation, installation-related characteristics)
test_case: Review of lamp design and documentation against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 for reversing lamps on M1, evaluated during lamp type approval; pass if all requirements verifiable at lamp level are met.

text: The lamps (rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions of the rear combination lamp) shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp: rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions; housing, LED modules on PCB, connector, fasteners/clips, seal
test_case: Design review plus vibration/durability validation representative of vehicle use (e.g. OEM vibration profile); after exposure, all lamp functions shall operate correctly with no loosening, cracking, connector or LED failure.

text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp: photometric and colorimetric characteristics of rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions; outer lens, reflector, LED modules
test_case: After vibration/durability exposure, repeat photometric (luminous intensity distribution) and colour measurements per UN R148; results shall still comply with the prescribed values.

text: If the rear position lamp or stop lamp is an assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as a lamp marked "D", the "D" approval shall be applied only to the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions (not to the reversing lamp function).
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp functions (LED modules, housing)
test_case: Document and drawing review: check whether any function is built as two independent lamps; confirm that "D" is claimed only for the rear position and stop lamp functions and that the approval marking contains "D" for those functions only.

text: If the rear position lamp or stop lamp is an interdependent lamp system to be type approved as lamps marked "Y", the "Y" approval shall be applied only to the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions (not to the reversing lamp function).
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp functions (LED modules on PCB, outer lens, housing)
test_case: Document and drawing review: check whether any function is an interdependent lamp system; confirm that "Y" is claimed only for the rear position and stop lamp functions and that the approval marking contains "Y" for those functions only.

text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, these functions shall either (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source), or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp functions (LED modules on PCB, if reciprocally incorporated)
test_case: Design review of the LED/PCB architecture: verify that the rear position and stop functions use multiple independent light sources, or that the intended vehicle installation has a lamp-failure tell-tale; pass if either condition is met.

text: If a manufacturer logo is incorporated in the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of a lamp function, only one manufacturer logo, built by transparent or non-transparent components, shall be incorporated, and all requirements for that specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.
applies_to: Outer lens / optical components of the rear position lamp function
test_case: Visual inspection for the number of logos within the apparent surface, plus the full photometric and colorimetric tests of the function with the logo present; pass if there is at most one logo and all function requirements are met.

text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., any logo incorporated in the lamp shall be only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer.
applies_to: Outer lens / optical components (logo)
test_case: Inspect the logo design and check it against the applicant statement (paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)); pass if the logo is the vehicle or body manufacturer brand logo only.

text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
applies_to: Outer lens / optical components (logo) of the rear position lamp
test_case: Measure the projected enclosed light emitting area of the logo in the direction of the reference axis; pass if the area is ≤ 100 cm2.

text: The stop lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (outer lens / optics)
test_case: Visual inspection of the stop lamp apparent surface and optics; pass if no logo is present.

text: The reversing lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (outer lens / optics)
test_case: Visual inspection of the reversing lamp apparent surface and optics; pass if no logo is present.

text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light shall be considered to be one light source.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (LED modules on PCB, LED wiring/grouping)
test_case: Review LED circuit schematic and PCB layout to identify LED groups wired in series or with common failure; disconnect or open-circuit one LED per group and verify all LEDs of the group stop emitting. Pass: every group treated as one light source in the failure analysis of 4.6.1.2.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a rear position lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution in Annex 3, with the maximum intensities not exceeded when all light sources are illuminated, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure as indicated in paragraph 6.10.8. of UN Regulation No. 48 shall be produced.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (LED modules, driver electronics)
test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 3 with each single light source (group) failed in turn: all Annex 3 minimum values met; with all light sources lit: no maximum exceeded. Alternatively, simulate each single failure and verify the failure signal for the tell-tale is produced at the connector. Pass: one of the two options fulfilled for every single failure.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a stop lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution in Annex 3, with the maximum intensities not exceeded when all light sources are illuminated, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure as indicated in paragraph 6.7.8. of UN Regulation No. 48 shall be produced.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (LED array, driver electronics)
test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 3 with each single light source (group) failed in turn: all Annex 3 minimum values met; with all light sources lit: no maximum exceeded. Alternatively, simulate each single failure and verify the failure signal for the tell-tale is produced. Pass: one of the two options fulfilled for every single failure.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a reversing lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution in Annex 3, with the maximum intensities not exceeded when all light sources are illuminated, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure as indicated in paragraph 6.4.8. of UN Regulation No. 48 shall be produced.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (LED modules, driver electronics)
test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 3 with each single light source (group) failed in turn: all Annex 3 minimum values met; with all light sources lit: no maximum exceeded. Alternatively, simulate each single failure and verify the failure signal for the tell-tale is produced. Pass: one of the two options fulfilled for every single failure.

text: If the failure provision is met by producing a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, the lamp shall only be used on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on M1 vehicle (electrical connector / vehicle interface)
test_case: Check that, where option (b) is used, the communication form note is present and the vehicle electrical architecture includes the failure tell-tale; verify tell-tale activation on vehicle by simulating a single light source failure. Pass: tell-tale activates.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, in case of failure of the variable intensity control the requirements of steady luminous intensity of category R2 shall be fulfilled automatically.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function with variable intensity control (if category R2)
test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control (open/short of control input, controller fault) and measure photometry per Annex 3. Pass: steady luminous intensity requirements of category R2 met automatically without intervention.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, in case of failure of the variable intensity control the requirements of steady luminous intensity of category S2 shall be fulfilled automatically.
applies_to: Stop lamp function with variable intensity control (if category S2)
test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure photometry per Annex 3. Pass: steady luminous intensity requirements of category S2 met automatically.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, in case of failure of the variable intensity control the requirements of steady luminous intensity of category S4 shall be fulfilled automatically.
applies_to: Stop lamp function with variable intensity control (if category S4)
test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure photometry per Annex 3. Pass: steady luminous intensity requirements of category S4 met automatically.

text: The rear combination lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128 (provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval), and/or light source module(s), and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (light sources for rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: Design review and inspection of the lamp and drawings: verify every light source is a non-replaceable LED source, a light source module, or a replaceable source approved to UN R37/R99/R128. Pass if no other light source type is used.

text: The light signalling device shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, LED drive electronics and connector of the rear combination lamp
test_case: EMC assessment at vehicle-type level (e.g. UN R10 radiated and conducted emission tests) with all lamp functions operated. Pass if emissions are within limits and no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems is observed.

text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable light source modules)
test_case: Attempt to fit the module in any position or orientation other than the designated one. Pass if fitting is only possible in the correct position.

text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall only be removable with the use of tool(s).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable light source modules)
test_case: Attempt to remove the module by hand without tools. Pass if removal is only possible with tool(s).

text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall be tamperproof.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable light source modules)
test_case: Inspection of the module design (sealing, non-dismountable construction). Pass if the module cannot be opened or modified without visible damage.

text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall, regardless of the use of tool(s), not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and module interfaces in housing (if replaceable light source modules)
test_case: Attempt to fit replaceable UN approved light sources into the module seat, and the module into lamp holders, with and without tools. Pass if no interchange is possible.

text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall, regardless of the use of tool(s), not be interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
applies_to: LED modules for stop, rear position and reversing functions in the same housing (if replaceable light source modules)
test_case: Attempt to swap modules of different functions or characteristics between their seats in the same housing, with and without tools. Pass if no swap is possible.

text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and photometric performance of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (if replaceable light source modules)
test_case: Replace the module with another sample bearing the same identification code, then repeat the photometric measurements per UN R148. Pass if all photometric requirements are met.
