text: All photometric and colorimetric measurements of the rear combination lamp shall be made under the conditions of paragraph 4.8.1, using the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
applies_to: All lamp functions (rear position, stop, reversing)
test_case: Review test setup against Annex 3 methods; pass if all photometric/colorimetric measurements follow 4.8.1 conditions.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / all lamp functions
test_case: Photometric and colorimetric tests per Annex 3 on complete lamp with its own LED modules fitted; pass if no substitute or external sources are used.

text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
applies_to: Photometric test setup for all lamp functions
test_case: Inspect goniophotometer setup; pass if masking prevents stray reflections reaching the photometer.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp LED light sources
test_case: Photometry per Annex 3 with LEDs in steady-on operation; pass if measured continuously lit unless otherwise specified.

text: In case the results of measurements are challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
applies_to: Photometric test setup
test_case: Verify photometric distance is in far field (inverse-square law valid) for the lamp's apparent surface.

text: In case the results of measurements are challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
applies_to: Photometric test setup
test_case: Calculate receiver angular aperture from reference centre; pass if between 10' and 1°.

text: The intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
applies_to: Luminous intensity of all lamp functions
test_case: Where a grid point fails, measure within ±0.25° of the direction; pass if requirement met within that deviation.

text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of each light-signalling lamp function shall be determined.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (outer lens / reflector)
test_case: Determine apparent surface boundaries viewed along the reference axis per Annex 3; pass if limits documented for each function.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems).
applies_to: Electrical supply via PCB connector, all lamp functions
test_case: Measure voltage at lamp connector during photometry; pass if 13.5 V for 12 V systems (6.75 V / 28 V for 6 V / 24 V systems).

text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated for testing as specified by the applicant.
applies_to: LED driver/control electronics on PCB (if present)
test_case: Operate lamp with applicant-specified control gear and settings during photometry; pass if test conditions match applicant specification.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control and equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB
test_case: Operate lamp at applicant-specified supply conditions during photometry; pass if conditions match specification.

text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the stop lamp function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Annex 3/Annex 8 photometry at HV on both samples; pass if ≥ paragraph 5 minimum.

text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the stop lamp function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Goniophotometric scan over visible directions on both samples; pass if no value exceeds paragraph 5 maximum.

text: Outside the reference axis, the intensity of the stop lamp shall be not less than the product of the minimum specified in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction, or not less than the intensity value specified in that figure for each direction.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Measure each grid point of Annex 3 light distribution figure; pass if every point meets its percentage/value.

text: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, the intensity of the stop lamp shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the stop lamp function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Measure across Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if ≥ paragraph 5 minimum everywhere.

text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the rear position lamp function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Photometry at HV on both samples; pass if ≥ paragraph 5 minimum.

text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the rear position lamp function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Goniophotometric scan over visible directions; pass if no value exceeds paragraph 5 maximum.

text: Outside the reference axis, the intensity of the rear position lamp shall be not less than the product of the minimum specified in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction, or not less than the intensity value specified in that figure for each direction.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Measure each Annex 3 grid point; pass if every point meets its percentage/value.

text: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, the intensity of the rear position lamp shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the rear position lamp function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Measure across Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if ≥ paragraph 5 minimum.

text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the reversing lamp function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Photometry at HV on both samples; pass if ≥ paragraph 5 minimum.

text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the reversing lamp function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Goniophotometric scan over visible directions; pass if no value exceeds paragraph 5 maximum.

text: Outside the reference axis, the intensity of the reversing lamp shall be not less than the product of the minimum specified in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction, or not less than the intensity value specified in that figure for each direction.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Measure each Annex 3 grid point; pass if every point meets its percentage/value.

text: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, the intensity of the reversing lamp shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the reversing lamp function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Measure across Annex 2 geometric visibility angles (incl. 45° outboard); pass if ≥ paragraph 5 minimum.

text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed for each lamp function.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamps
test_case: Where visual examination shows local intensity variations, check per Annex 3 local variation criteria; pass if criteria met.

text: If the applicant requests the additional test to verify visibility of red light towards the front, the maximum intensity of the red lamp functions in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall be not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (optional test)
test_case: Measure intensity over 165°–180° outboard H, -2.5° to +5° V, optionally with vehicle body influence; pass if max ≤ 0.25 cd.

text: Where the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously and the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
applies_to: Rear position lamp / stop lamp (reciprocally incorporated)
test_case: Measure intensities in ±5° V × ±10° H field with stop+position lit and with position lit alone; pass if ratio ≥ 5:1 at each point.

text: If one or both of the reciprocally incorporated rear position and stop lamps contain more than one light source and are considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered for the 5:1 ratio shall be those obtained with all sources in operation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp / stop lamp LED arrays
test_case: Perform ratio measurement with all LED sources of each function energised; pass if ratio ≥ 5:1.

text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamps
test_case: Conduct luminous intensity compliance tests per Annex 8 procedure; pass if Annex 8 criteria met.

text: The colour of the light emitted by each lamp function (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3, applying the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions; outer lens (colour definition)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement per paragraph 4.8 at points within the Annex 3 light distribution grid for each function; chromaticity coordinates within the limits prescribed for the function's colour (red for rear position/stop, white for reversing).

text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined in Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed for the light emitted by each lamp function.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions; outer lens
test_case: Visual/colorimetric examination outside the Annex 3 grid field with the lamp lit; pass if no sharp variation of colour is observed.

text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (non-replaceable light sources) for rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Colorimetric check per relevant subparagraphs of 4.8 with the lamp's own LED modules installed and energised; colour within prescribed limits.

text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
applies_to: Lamp functions combining different light source technologies (if any) in the rear combination lamp
test_case: Separate colorimetric measurement per paragraphs 4.8.1 and 4.8.2 for each light source technology, using samples allowing separate supply of each light source; each within prescribed colour limits.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp supplied shall meet the luminous intensity and standard light distribution requirements in Table 4.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function
test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1; pass if every Table 4 value is met by each sample.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady), its minimum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R1)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per Par. 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 4 cd.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and used as a single lamp, its maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall not exceed 1.7∙10^1 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R1)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per Par. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if intensity ≤ 17 cd in all directions.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), its maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall not exceed 8.5∙10^0 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R1, marked D)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per Par. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if intensity ≤ 8.5 cd in all directions.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady), its standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall comply with Figure A3-I and Table A2-1.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R1)
test_case: Measure at grid points of Figure A3-I per Par. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if values per Table A2-1 are met.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady), its minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) shall be 5∙10^-2 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R1)
test_case: Measure across the geometric visibility field per Par. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if intensity ≥ 0.05 cd everywhere.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable), its minimum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R2)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per Par. 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 4 cd.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable) and used as a single lamp, its maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall not exceed 4.2∙10^1 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R2)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per Par. 4.8.3.1 (b) under all variable intensity conditions; pass if intensity ≤ 42 cd.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable) and marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), its maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall not exceed 2.1∙10^1 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R2, marked D)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per Par. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if intensity ≤ 21 cd.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable), its standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall comply with Figure A3-I and Table A2-1.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R2)
test_case: Measure at grid points of Figure A3-I per Par. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if values per Table A2-1 are met.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable), its minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) shall be 5∙10^-2 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (category R2)
test_case: Measure across the geometric visibility field per Par. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if intensity ≥ 0.05 cd everywhere.

text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, a luminous intensity of up to 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with stop lamp
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement below -5° vertical; pass if intensity ≤ 60 cd there, and Table 4 maxima met elsewhere.

text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function / outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries of the regulation.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
applies_to: Stop lamp function
test_case: Photometric measurement on both samples per para. 4.8.3.1; pass if every Table 7 value for the declared category (S1 or S2) is met.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), its minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd (60 cd).
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S1)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (a) on both samples; pass if intensity is ≥ 60 cd where required.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and used as a single lamp, its maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 2.60∙10^2 cd (260 cd).
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S1, single lamp)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no measured intensity exceeds 260 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and marked "D" (para. 3.3.2.5.2.), its maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 1.30∙10^2 cd (130 cd).
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S1, lamp marked "D")
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no measured intensity exceeds 130 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1, its standard light distribution shall conform to Figure A3-I.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S1)
test_case: Measurement at grid points of Figure A3-I per para. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the required percentage of minimum intensity.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1, the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be at least 3∙10^-1 cd (0.3 cd).
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S1)
test_case: Measurement across geometric visibility angles of Table A2-1 per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if ≥ 0.3 cd throughout.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), its minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd (60 cd).
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S2)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (a) on both samples; pass if intensity is ≥ 60 cd where required.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and used as a single lamp, its maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 7.30∙10^2 cd (730 cd).
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S2, single lamp)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no measured intensity exceeds 730 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and marked "D" (para. 3.3.2.5.2.), its maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 3.65∙10^2 cd (365 cd).
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S2, lamp marked "D")
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no measured intensity exceeds 365 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2, its standard light distribution shall conform to Figure A3-I.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S2)
test_case: Measurement at grid points of Figure A3-I per para. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the required percentage of minimum intensity.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2, the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be at least 3∙10^-1 cd (0.3 cd) in day condition.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S2, day mode)
test_case: Measurement across geometric visibility angles of Table A2-1 in day mode per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if ≥ 0.3 cd throughout.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2, the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be at least 7∙10^-2 cd (0.07 cd) in night condition.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (category S2, night mode)
test_case: Measurement across geometric visibility angles of Table A2-1 in night mode per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if ≥ 0.07 cd throughout.

text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
applies_to: Stop lamp function / outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light through the outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries defined in the regulation.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp (category AR) supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function
test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1; pass if all Table 10 values (minimum, maximum, standard light distribution Figure A3-V) are met by each sample.

text: The reversing lamp of category AR shall emit a minimum luminous intensity of 8.0∙10^1 cd (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (a)).
applies_to: Reversing lamp function
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement at the reference axis/test points of the standard light distribution; pass if intensity ≥ 80 cd.

text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the H-plane (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Reversing lamp function
test_case: Goniophotometer scan in and above the H-plane; pass if maximum intensity ≤ 300 cd.

text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 6.00∙10^2 cd below the H-plane, down to 5°D (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Reversing lamp function
test_case: Goniophotometer scan from H-plane down to 5°D; pass if maximum intensity ≤ 600 cd.

text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Reversing lamp function
test_case: Goniophotometer scan below 5°D; pass if maximum intensity ≤ 8000 cd.

text: The light distribution of the reversing lamp of category AR shall comply with the standard light distribution defined in Figure A3-V (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (c)).
applies_to: Reversing lamp function
test_case: Measure intensities at all Figure A3-V grid points; pass if each value meets the percentage of the minimum specified in Figure A3-V.

text: If the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied up to an angle of 30° inwards, where the photometric intensity is verified only up to that angle.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (pair-only installation)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement inward up to 30°; pass if intensity ≥ 25 cd; condition declared in approval documents (paragraph 3.1.).

text: If type approval is granted under the pair-only condition, the reversing lamp shall only be installed on the vehicle in a pair.
applies_to: Reversing lamp installation on M1 vehicle (left and right rear corners)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection; pass if two reversing lamps are fitted as a pair, consistent with item 9.1.3 of the communication form.

text: The reversing lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (LED modules on PCB)
test_case: Failure tests per paragraph 4.6 (e.g. LED/light source failure simulation); pass if paragraph 4.6 criteria are met.

text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function / outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the white colour boundaries defined in the regulation.

text: The rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions) shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under UN R148.
applies_to: Complete rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp functions)
test_case: Conformity of production check: compare production samples against the approved type (drawings, markings, photometry, colour); pass if samples match the approved type and meet paragraph 5 requirements.

text: The minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 4 of UN R148 shall be complied with for the rear combination lamp.
applies_to: Production of the rear combination lamp (all R148 lamp functions)
test_case: Audit of the manufacturer's CoP control procedures per Annex 4 (test frequency, recorded photometric and colorimetric checks, corrective actions); pass if all Annex 4 minimum requirements are implemented and documented.

text: The minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 5 of UN R148 shall be complied with for the rear combination lamp.
applies_to: Production of the rear combination lamp (all R148 lamp functions)
test_case: Inspector sampling per Annex 5: randomly selected production lamps measured; pass if the Annex 5 sampling acceptance criteria are met.

text: For conformity of production of the rear combination lamp, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in UN R148.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp photometric and colorimetric values
test_case: Photometric/colorimetric measurement of production samples per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if every measured value is within 20 per cent unfavourable deviation of the prescribed value.

text: For a required minimum value of 7∙10-1 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured value of the rear combination lamp shall correspond to 5∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 3∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp minimum intensities in the fields of Annexes 2 and 3
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of production samples across the Annex 2/3 fields; pass if points requiring 7∙10-1 cd measure at least 5∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) or 3∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level) as applicable per Annex 5.

text: For a required minimum value of 6∙10-1 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured value of the rear combination lamp shall correspond to 4∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 2∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp minimum intensities in the fields of Annexes 2 and 3
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the Annex 2/3 fields; pass if points requiring 6∙10-1 cd measure at least 4∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) or 2∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level).

text: For a required minimum value of 3∙10-1 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured value of the rear combination lamp shall correspond to 2∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 1∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp minimum intensities in the fields of Annexes 2 and 3
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the Annex 2/3 fields; pass if points requiring 3∙10-1 cd measure at least 2∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) or 1∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level).

text: For a required minimum value of 7∙10-2 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured value of the rear combination lamp shall correspond to 5∙10-2 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 3∙10-2 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp minimum intensities in the fields of Annexes 2 and 3
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the Annex 2/3 fields; pass if points requiring 7∙10-2 cd measure at least 5∙10-2 cd (20 per cent level) or 3∙10-2 cd (30 per cent level).

text: For a required minimum value of 5∙10-2 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured value of the rear combination lamp shall correspond to 3∙10-2 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 2∙10-2 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp minimum intensities in the fields of Annexes 2 and 3
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the Annex 2/3 fields; pass if points requiring 5∙10-2 cd measure at least 3∙10-2 cd (20 per cent level) or 2∙10-2 cd (30 per cent level).

text: The angles of geometric visibility of Annex 2 apply as shown to lamps mounted on the right side of the vehicle; for the lamp mounted on the left side of the vehicle the same angles shall be applied mirrored (inboard/outboard interchanged).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp, left and right installation (rear position and stop functions)
test_case: Drawing/CAD review of the left and right lamps: confirm the inboard/outboard visibility angles are mirrored correctly for each side. Pass if each side meets the Table A2-1 values in its own inboard/outboard sense.

text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 80° outboard.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function; outer lens, housing and vehicle rear body contour
test_case: Check geometric visibility of the apparent surface on a goniometer or CAD sight-line analysis, lamp installed per vehicle drawing. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.

text: If the rear position lamp (R1, R2) is mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard may be used only below the H-plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function, installation height below 750 mm
test_case: Measure the H-plane mounting height. If below 750 mm, verify by goniometer or CAD that visibility is at least 45°/80° above the H-plane and at least 20°/80° below it.

text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and 15° below the H-plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function; outer lens and housing
test_case: Goniometer or CAD sight-line check of the apparent surface, lamp installed. Pass if the surface is unobstructed from 15° up to 15° down.

text: If the rear position lamp (R1, R2) is installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and 5° below.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function, installation height below 750 mm
test_case: Measure the mounting height. If below 750 mm, verify visibility from 15° up to 5° down. Pass if unobstructed.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category MR and singular, it shall have minimum horizontal angles of 80° inboard / 80° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15° above / 5° below for an H-plane mounting height of less than 750 mm).
applies_to: Rear position lamp function, if category MR singular
test_case: Goniometer or CAD visibility check against these angles. Pass if all are met.

text: If the rear position lamps are of category MR and installed as a pair, each lamp shall have minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15° above / 5° below for an H-plane mounting height of less than 750 mm).
applies_to: Rear position lamp function, if category MR pair
test_case: Goniometer or CAD visibility check against these angles. Pass if all are met.

text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 45° outboard.
applies_to: Stop lamp function; outer lens, housing and vehicle rear body contour
test_case: Goniometer or CAD sight-line check of the apparent surface, lamp installed. Pass if unobstructed from 45° inboard to 45° outboard.

text: If the stop lamp (S1, S2) is mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 45° outboard may be used only below the H-plane.
applies_to: Stop lamp function, installation height below 750 mm
test_case: Measure the mounting height. If below 750 mm, verify at least 45°/45° above the H-plane and at least 20°/45° below it.

text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and 15° below the H-plane.
applies_to: Stop lamp function
test_case: Goniometer or CAD sight-line check. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° up to 15° down.

text: If the stop lamp (S1, S2) is installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and 5° below.
applies_to: Stop lamp function, installation height below 750 mm
test_case: Measure the mounting height. If below 750 mm, verify visibility from 15° up to 5° down. Pass if unobstructed.

text: If the stop lamp is of category MS and singular, it shall have minimum horizontal angles of 45° inboard / 45° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15° above / 5° below for an H-plane mounting height of less than 750 mm).
applies_to: Stop lamp function, if category MS singular
test_case: Goniometer or CAD visibility check against these angles. Pass if all are met.

text: If the stop lamps are of category MS and installed as a pair, each lamp shall have minimum horizontal angles of 0° inboard / 45° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15° above / 5° below for an H-plane mounting height of less than 750 mm).
applies_to: Stop lamp function, if category MS pair
test_case: Goniometer or CAD visibility check against these angles. Pass if all are met.

text: Unless specified otherwise, the values of the standard light distribution figures giving the minimum intensities for the various directions of measurement as a percentage of the minimum intensities required shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp photometric minimum intensities
test_case: Photometric goniometer measurement about the reference axis (H = 0°, V = 0°) through the centre of reference. Compute each grid-point minimum as the Figure A3-I percentage × the required minimum intensity, rounded down to three significant digits. Pass if every measured value ≥ its computed minimum.

text: If the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer), the photometric intensity shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
applies_to: Rear position lamp photometry / installation height
test_case: Check the declared mounting height of the rear position lamp. If it is ≤ 750 mm, verify Figure A3-I photometry only down to V = 5° downwards. Pass if all points within the reduced field meet their minima.

text: If the stop lamp of category S1 or S2 is intended to be installed at a mounting height equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer), the photometric intensity shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
applies_to: Stop lamp (S1/S2) photometry / installation height
test_case: Check the declared mounting height of the stop lamp. If it is ≤ 750 mm, verify Figure A3-I photometry only down to V = 5° downwards. Pass if all points within the reduced field meet their minima.

text: Within the field of light distribution shown as a grid, the light intensity of the rear position lamp in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value shown, as a percentage, on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction.
applies_to: Rear position lamp light distribution uniformity
test_case: Goniometer scan between the grid points of Figure A3-I. Pass if every intermediate direction ≥ the lowest minimum percentage of the surrounding grid lines × the required minimum intensity.

text: Within the field of light distribution shown as a grid, the light intensity of the stop lamp in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value shown, as a percentage, on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction.
applies_to: Stop lamp light distribution uniformity
test_case: Goniometer scan between the grid points of Figure A3-I. Pass if every intermediate direction ≥ the lowest minimum percentage of the surrounding grid lines × the required minimum intensity.

text: When visual examination of a reversing lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement shall be below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
applies_to: Reversing lamp light distribution uniformity
test_case: Visually inspect the lit reversing lamp. If local variations are seen, scan intensity between adjacent Figure A3-V measuring points. Pass if each intermediate value ≥ 50 % of the lower prescribed minimum of the two adjacent points.

text: The rear position lamp shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given in Figure A3-I as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 3).
applies_to: Rear position lamp photometry
test_case: Goniometer measurement at all Figure A3-I measuring points. Pass if each point ≥ its percentage × the Table 3 minimum intensity.

text: The stop lamp of category S1 or S2 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given in Figure A3-I as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7).
applies_to: Stop lamp (S1/S2) photometry
test_case: Goniometer measurement at all Figure A3-I measuring points. Pass if each point ≥ its percentage × the Table 7 minimum intensity.

text: The reversing lamp shall emit, at the measuring points expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference, at least the minimum intensities in cd given in Figure A3-V.
applies_to: Reversing lamp photometry
test_case: Goniometer measurement about the reference axis (H = 0°, V = 0°, horizontal and parallel to the vehicle median longitudinal plane) at each Figure A3-V point. Pass if each measured intensity ≥ the cd value shown.

text: From a mechanical and geometric standpoint, the differences of mass-produced rear combination lamps from the approved type shall not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
applies_to: Housing, outer lens, retro-reflector, reflector and fasteners (mechanical and geometric conformity)
test_case: Dimensional/geometric inspection of production samples against approved drawings; pass if deviations are within inevitable manufacturing tolerances and the Regulation's requirements.

text: With respect to photometric performances, any rear combination lamp chosen at random from mass production shall meet the photometric requirements when tested according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions (photometry)
test_case: Photometric test of a randomly selected production lamp per paragraph 4.8.; pass if conformity is not contestable under that paragraph.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of the light emitted by mass-produced rear combination lamps shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Outer lens / LED light sources (colour of rear position, stop and reversing lamp light)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement per paragraph 4.9.; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed colour boundaries for each function.

text: For each type of lamp, the holder of the type approval shall carry out conformity of production tests at appropriate intervals, in accordance with the provisions of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp production (manufacturer CoP)
test_case: Audit of CoP test plan and records; pass if tests are performed at defined appropriate intervals per Regulation methods.

text: If any sampling shows non-conformity with regard to the type of test concerned, further samples shall be taken and tested.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp production (manufacturer CoP)
test_case: Review of non-conformity records; pass if additional samples were taken and tested following each failed sampling.

text: The manufacturer shall take steps to ensure the conformity of the production concerned.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp production (manufacturer CoP)
test_case: Review of corrective action records; pass if corrective actions were implemented and conformity restored.

text: Conformity of production tests shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics of the lamp.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions; outer lens
test_case: Review of CoP test plan; pass if both photometric and colorimetric tests are included.

text: Conformity of production tests shall generally be carried out in accordance with the methods set out in this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp CoP testing
test_case: Review of test procedures; pass if methods match those of UN R148 or are approved equivalent methods per paragraph 2.2.2.

text: Where equivalent test methods are used in conformity tests by the manufacturer, they shall have the consent of the competent authority and the manufacturer shall prove that the applied methods are equivalent to those laid down in this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp CoP testing
test_case: Review of authority consent and equivalence/correlation evidence; pass if documented.

text: Test apparatus used for conformity tests shall be regularly calibrated and correlated with measurements made by a competent authority.
applies_to: Photometric and colorimetric test equipment
test_case: Review of calibration certificates and correlation records; pass if calibration is current and correlation demonstrated.

text: Samples of lamps shall be selected at random from the production of a uniform batch (a set of lamps of the same type, defined according to the production methods of the manufacturer).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp CoP sampling
test_case: Review of sampling procedure; pass if samples are randomly drawn from uniform batches.

text: The CoP assessment shall in general cover series production from individual factories; records concerning the same type from several factories may only be grouped together if these operate under the same quality system and quality management.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp CoP records
test_case: Review of quality records; pass if assessment is per factory or grouped factories share the same quality system and management.

text: The sampled lamp shall be subjected to photometric measurements for the minimum values at the points listed in Annex 3.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (photometry)
test_case: Photometric measurement at Annex 3 points; pass if minimum intensity values are met.

text: The sampled lamp shall be subjected to measurement of the required chromaticity coordinates.
applies_to: Outer lens / LED light sources (colour)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement; pass if chromaticity coordinates are within required limits.

text: The manufacturer shall carry out a statistical study of the test results and define, in agreement with the competent authority, criteria governing the acceptability of the products to meet the requirements of paragraph 6.1. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp CoP acceptance criteria
test_case: Review of statistical analysis and agreed acceptance criteria; pass if documented and agreed with the authority.

text: The criteria governing acceptability shall be such that, with a confidence level of 95 per cent, the minimum probability of passing a spot check in accordance with Annex 5 would be 0.95.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp CoP acceptance criteria
test_case: Statistical verification of acceptance criteria; pass if probability of passing an Annex 5 spot check is ≥ 0.95 at 95 per cent confidence.

text: From a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, mass-produced rear combination lamps shall conform to the requirements of this Regulation, with differences not exceeding inevitable manufacturing deviations.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (housing, outer lens, retro-reflector, fasteners) – mechanical and geometric conformity of production
test_case: CoP inspection: dimensional and mechanical comparison of randomly selected production lamps against the approved type; pass if differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

text: With respect to photometric performance, when the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation are tested on any lamp chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions (LED light sources) – photometric conformity of production
test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8. on randomly chosen production lamps; pass if no measured value deviates from the values of paragraph 6.1.3.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced lamps shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Outer lens / light colour of rear position (red), stop (red) and reversing (white) lamp functions
test_case: Colorimetric measurement under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. on randomly chosen production lamps; pass if chromaticity coordinates are within the prescribed limits.

text: In inspector sampling, the photometric deviation of any specimen of the four randomly selected lamps (samples A and B) shall not be more than 20 per cent for the conformity of mass-produced lamps not to be contested.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp – photometric performance in CoP sampling
test_case: Annex 5 paragraph 2: select four lamps at random (samples A and B), measure photometry; pass if deviation of every specimen ≤ 20 per cent; measurement may be terminated if both lamps of sample A show 0 per cent deviation.

text: The approval marking arrangement of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated in the same assembly) shall be made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation; the arrangements shown in Annex 7 are examples only.
applies_to: Approval marking on housing / outer lens of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection of the marking on the sample against paragraph 3.3. and the Annex 7 examples (e.g. Figure A7-III). Pass if the marking shows the approval mark, approval number, 148R with series 01, and the function symbols for each function in an arrangement conforming to paragraph 3.3. (e.g. R or R2, S1/S2, AR, IA).

text: Where the lamp contains light source modules, each light source module shall bear an identification code consisting of 'MD' followed by the approval mark of the lamp with which it has been approved and the approval number (e.g. 'MD E3 17325'), in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation.
applies_to: LED light source modules on PCB
test_case: Visual inspection of each LED module. Pass if the code 'MD', the country code and the approval number of the lamp are present and match the lamp's approval marking, as in Figure A7-V.

text: For the reversing lamp using light source technology other than incandescent only (LED), the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (LED modules on PCB)
test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.1 after 1 min of operation; the distribution may be calculated from the distribution after photometric stability using the ratio of intensities at HV (1 min / stability). Pass: all test points within the min/max values of the reversing lamp requirements.

text: For the reversing lamp using light source technology other than incandescent only (LED), the luminous intensities measured after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (LED modules on PCB)
test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.1 after 10 min of operation; the distribution may be calculated from the distribution after photometric stability using the ratio of intensities at HV (10 min / stability). Pass: all test points within the min/max values.

text: For the rear position lamp using light source technology other than incandescent only (LED), the luminous intensities measured after 1 min of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function
test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2 after 1 min of operation; may be calculated from the distribution after 30 min or after photometric stabilization using the HV intensity ratio. Pass: all test points within min/max.

text: For the rear position lamp using light source technology other than incandescent only (LED), the luminous intensities measured either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function
test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2 after 30 min of operation or after photometric stability. Pass: all test points within min/max.

text: For the stop lamp using light source technology other than incandescent only (LED), the luminous intensities measured after 1 min of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (LED array)
test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2 after 1 min of operation; may be calculated from the distribution after 30 min or after photometric stabilization using the HV intensity ratio. Pass: all test points within min/max.

text: For the stop lamp using light source technology other than incandescent only (LED), the luminous intensities measured either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (LED array)
test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2 after 30 min of operation or after photometric stability. Pass: all test points within min/max.

text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp shall additionally comply at 4 seconds after switch ON, with reference coordinate HV.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function
test_case: Per Annex 8 para 2.1 / Table A8-1: check distribution at 4 s after switch ON (may be calculated from para 1 distribution using ratio at HV). Pass: min/max requirements met. For LED-only functions deemed compliant per para 2.1.2 if para 1.2 values comply.

text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the stop lamp shall additionally comply at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with reference coordinate HV.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (LED array)
test_case: Per Annex 8 para 2.1 / Table A8-1: check distribution at 0.2 s after switch ON (may be calculated from para 1 distribution using ratio at HV). Pass: min/max requirements met. For LED-only functions deemed compliant per para 2.1.2 if para 1.2 values comply.

text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp shall additionally comply at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with reference coordinate HV.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function
test_case: Per Annex 8 para 2.1 / Table A8-1: check distribution at 0.2 s after switch ON (may be calculated from para 1 distribution using ratio at HV). Pass: min/max requirements met. For LED-only functions deemed compliant per para 2.1.2 if para 1.2 values comply.

text: In case a lamp function uses LED technology only, the lamp function is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (LED only)
test_case: Verify by design documentation that each function uses LED technology only; pass if para 1.2.1/1.2.2 measurements comply.

text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the minimum intensity requirements of the rear position lamp shall be met at all points in time starting at 4 s after switch ON and ending when photometric stability is reached.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function
test_case: Continuous intensity measurement at HV from 4 s after switch ON until photometric stability. Pass: minimum intensity met throughout.

text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the minimum intensity requirements of the stop lamp shall be met at all points in time starting at 0.2 s after switch ON and ending when photometric stability is reached.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (LED array)
test_case: Continuous intensity measurement at HV from 0.2 s after switch ON until photometric stability. Pass: minimum intensity met throughout.

text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the minimum intensity requirements of the reversing lamp shall be met at all points in time starting at 0.2 s after switch ON and ending when photometric stability is reached.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function
test_case: Continuous intensity measurement at HV from 0.2 s after switch ON until photometric stability. Pass: minimum intensity met throughout.

text: Every retro-reflective device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and the other markings defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or for the approval marking and the other markings defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens / housing (marking space)
test_case: Drawing and sample inspection: confirm a dedicated marking area large enough for the UI or the full approval marking (with size 'a' per Table 1) plus 'TOP' and trade name where applicable. Pass if all required markings fit.

text: All markings on the retro-reflective device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
applies_to: All markings (approval marking/UI, trade name, TOP) on retro-reflector, lens, housing
test_case: Visual inspection for legibility, then indelibility check, e.g. rubbing with a cloth soaked in water and then petroleum spirit, plus marking check after environmental tests. Pass if markings stay fully legible and undamaged.

text: The size of the approval marking shall comply with the value for 'a' defined in Table 1, with the arrangement of markings as shown in the examples in Annex 10.
applies_to: Approval marking on retro-reflective device
test_case: Measure the approval mark dimensions on the drawing and sample against the value 'a' in Table 1. Pass if dimensions are at or above the minimum.

text: The approval marking shall include the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter 'E' followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of drawing and sample. Pass if a circle surrounding 'E' with the country distinguishing number is present.

text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection against the approval document. Pass if the correct 4–6 digit sequential number is marked.

text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
applies_to: Approval marking layout
test_case: Drawing and sample inspection of the layout per Annex 10 examples. Pass if the sequential number is adjacent to the E-circle.

text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
applies_to: Approval marking of integrated retro-reflector
test_case: Visual inspection of the marking against the class symbol defined in paragraph 3.2.5 for the approved retro-reflector class (e.g. IA). Pass if the correct symbol is present.

text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if '150R' followed by the correct two-digit series of amendments (e.g. 150R00) is marked.

text: If the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format of the example shown in Figure I.
applies_to: Unique Identifier marking (if used)
test_case: Compare the marked UI against the Figure I format and verify the UI against the UN secure internet database. Pass if format and UI match.

text: The retro-reflective device shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / lamp housing marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the sample. Pass if the applicant's trade name or mark is present, legible and indelible.

text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective device shall bear the word 'TOP' inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
applies_to: Integrated retro-reflector (illuminating surface)
test_case: Review the retro-reflector's rotational symmetry and the manufacturer's prescribed rotation angles. If orientation is ambiguous, inspect for a horizontal 'TOP' on the highest part of the illuminating surface. Pass if present when required.

text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
applies_to: Marking location on retro-reflective device
test_case: Visual inspection of the sample in its as-delivered state. Pass if the approval marking/UI, trade name and TOP (if required) are clearly legible on the device.

text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the marking shall be visible after their installation.
applies_to: Single approval mark on rear combination lamp
test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the M1 vehicle (or a vehicle-representative fixture). Pass if the single marking is visible without removing the lamp.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
applies_to: Outer lens, retro-reflector and other light-transmitting parts vs. marking location
test_case: Design review and disassembly check of every detachable light-transmitting part. Pass if each such part carries the mark, or its removal necessarily removes the mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
applies_to: Single approval mark on combined lamp
test_case: Measure the mark components and compare with the minimum sizes of the individual marks required by UN R148 and R150 (and other applicable Regulations). Pass if all components are at or above the smallest required minimum.

text: The conformity of production procedures for the retro-reflector approved under UN R150 shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the requirements of paragraph 3.5.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector (production quality system)
test_case: Audit of the manufacturer's CoP procedures against 1958 Agreement Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3); pass if procedures are documented and implemented accordingly.

text: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: Production samples tested to the photometric, colorimetric and physical requirements of paragraphs 4. and 5. of UN R150; pass if samples conform to the approved type.

text: For the retro-reflector, the minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 shall be complied with.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector (manufacturer's production control)
test_case: Review of production control records and tests per Annex 2 of UN R150 (test types, frequencies, sampling); pass if Annex 2 minimum requirements are met.

text: For the retro-reflector, the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 3 shall be complied with.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector (CoP inspection sampling)
test_case: Inspector samples retro-reflectors per Annex 3 of UN R150 and measures them; pass if sample results meet the Annex 3 acceptance criteria.

text: The rear retro-reflector shall comply with the requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications", and in the Annexes referenced in those sections, of UN Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (integrated in rear combination lamp, M1 vehicle)
test_case: Review of device design and installation data against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 and referenced Annexes (series in force at time of application); pass if all applicable rear retro-reflector provisions are met.

text: The requirements of UN Regulation No. 48 pertinent to the rear retro-reflector and to vehicle category M1, on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed, shall be applied where their verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector – installation on M1 vehicle rear (outboard corners, left and right)
test_case: At device type approval, verify the R48 installation provisions for the rear retro-reflector on M1 that can be checked on the device (e.g. geometric visibility angles, orientation, illuminating surface, colour) using the device and intended mounting data; pass if all verifiable provisions are met.

text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (integrated in rear combination lamp)
test_case: Design review and completion of the R150 durability tests (heat resistance, water/dust penetration, corrosion, fuel/lubricating oil resistance); photometric values remain within limits after the tests.

text: The retro-reflector shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector, housing and seal/gasket
test_case: Visual inspection and design review of samples; no defect affecting retro-reflective performance or maintainability; photometric compliance confirmed.

text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector, outer lens, housing and fasteners/clips
test_case: Manual dismantling attempt without tools on the assembled lamp; pass if retro-reflector components cannot be easily separated.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
applies_to: Outer lens / retro-reflector outer surface
test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; pass if it can be cleaned easily.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough.
applies_to: Outer lens / retro-reflector outer surface
test_case: Visual and tactile inspection; pass if no roughness is present on the outer surface.

text: Any protuberances on the outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not prevent easy cleaning.
applies_to: Outer lens / retro-reflector outer surface
test_case: Inspection of outer surface geometry; pass if protuberances do not hinder cleaning.

text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector, housing, outer lens and seal/gasket
test_case: Inspection of the lamp as mounted; pass if the inner (reflective) surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.

text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, these shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector optical unit and filter / outer lens
test_case: Design review and manual separation attempt under normal-use conditions; pass if optical unit and filter cannot be separated.

text: The retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector optical unit and filter (red colour)
test_case: Material/drawing review and inspection of samples; pass if colour is obtained by the material itself (e.g. coloured mass), not by paint or varnish.

text: For testing the colour of the red rear retro-reflector, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (red, integrated in rear combination lamp)
test_case: Colorimetric test per R150 para. 4.2.1.2. Set up CIE Standard Illuminant A with 1/3° divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°. If a colourless surface reflection occurs, use the angle given in Annex 4, Part 1, para. 1.1. Pass if the test geometry and illuminant are documented as specified.

text: When illuminated under the conditions of paragraph 4.2.1.2, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the rear retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour (red) of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (red, integrated in rear combination lamp); outer lens colour definition
test_case: Measure the x,y chromaticity coordinates of the retro-reflected light with a spectroradiometer or colorimeter under Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence, β1 = β2 = 0° (or the alternative angle from Annex 4, Part 1, para. 1.1). Pass if the coordinates lie within the red night-time retro-reflected colour boundaries defined in UN R48.

text: For the determination of the luminance factor, the retro-reflector sample shall be tested with the method described in Part 2 of Annex 4.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (passive conspicuity)
test_case: Measure the luminance factor of a retro-reflector sample using the method in Part 2 of Annex 4. Pass if the method is applied as described and the measured luminance factor meets the value prescribed for the colour of the device.

text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: Visual inspection of shape and dimensions per Annex 5 on all ten samples (Table 4); pass if Annex 5 requirements are met

text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 and colorimetry per paragraph 4.2.1; pass if RI values of 5.1.4 and colour limits of 5.1.5 are met

text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective device.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector, optical units and housing materials
test_case: Test sequence of Table 4 (Classes IA, IB) on ten samples; pass if all tests and subsequent visual, colour and photometric checks are satisfactory

text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C) without distortion and, at least one hour after this test, shall meet the colorimetric requirements of paragraph 5.1.5. and the RI requirements of paragraph 5.1.4. for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: All ten samples: 48 h at 65 ± 2 °C per Part 1 Annex 6; visual check for distortion; after ≥1 h, colorimetry and RI at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° (or positions of Part 1 Annex 4 para 1.1/1.2); pass if no distortion and limits met; min and max samples then fully photometrically tested

text: The retro-reflector shall pass the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and subsequently the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector, seal/gasket, outer lens
test_case: First group (2 samples): water 10 min normal + 10 min inverted position, visual inspection; motor fuels 5 min and oils 5 min with visual inspection; then colour and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if no water penetration/damage and colour and RI comply

text: The retro-reflector shall, if necessary, pass the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6 and then the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector rear face
test_case: Second group (2 samples): corrosion 24 h, 2 h interval, 24 h, visual inspection; rear face abrasion 1 min, visual inspection; then colour and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if compliant

text: The retro-reflector shall pass the test for stability in time of the optical properties of the retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector optical units
test_case: Third group (2 samples): stability in time per Part 3 Annex 4; then colorimetry (visual or trichromatic) and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if compliant

text: The retro-reflector shall pass the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector, outer lens material
test_case: Fourth group (2 samples): weathering per Part 6 Annex 6; then colorimetry and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if compliant

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: Colorimetry per paragraph 4.2 (visual, trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt) after each test group; pass if within red night-time limits

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per Part 1 Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° after each test group; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx (red)

text: Where more than one or a range of axes of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the retro-reflector shall meet the photometric requirements for each axis of reference or for the extreme axes of reference of the range specified.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: Repeat photometric measurements per Part 1 Annex 4 for each declared axis or extreme axes of range; pass if Table 3 values met each time

text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device, contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB, shall be considered, and the illuminating surface shall be limited to 100 cm2.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector illuminating surface
test_case: Check declared perimeter of illuminating surface; mask to ≤100 cm2 within 200 mm diameter circle during photometry

text: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area of the retro-reflector to be used for photometric measurements.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector documentation/drawing
test_case: Document review: perimeter of illuminating surface indicated on drawings

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than 3.00·10^2 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Integrated red rear retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per para 3 Part 1 Annex 4, α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than 2.00·10^2 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Integrated red rear retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry, α = 20', β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 200 mcd/lx

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than 1.00·10^2 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
applies_to: Integrated red rear retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry, α = 20', β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; pass if RI ≥ 100 mcd/lx

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than 5 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Integrated red rear retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry, α = 1°30', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 5 mcd/lx

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than 2.8 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Integrated red rear retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry, α = 1°30', β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 2.8 mcd/lx

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than 2.5 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
applies_to: Integrated red rear retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry, α = 1°30', β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; pass if RI ≥ 2.5 mcd/lx

text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°) are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
applies_to: Integrated red rear retro-reflector
test_case: Photometric scan within the bounded solid angle; pass if RI ≥ 100 mcd/lx at 20' and ≥ 2.5 mcd/lx at 1°30' throughout

text: If the Class IA or IB retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector, installation height on vehicle
test_case: If declared mounting height < 750 mm, photometry for downward angles limited to 5°; pass if Table 3 values met within that range

text: The testing of the colour of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: Colorimetric measurement per paragraph 4.2.1

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the red retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
applies_to: Integrated red rear retro-reflector / outer lens colour
test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates of reflected light per para 4.2.1; pass if within UN R48 night-time red limits

text: From a mechanical and geometric standpoint, the differences between mass-produced retro-reflective devices and the approved type shall not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (integrated in rear combination lamp)
test_case: Dimensional/geometric inspection of production samples against approved drawings; pass if deviations stay within the requirements of UN R150.

text: When testing photometric performances of any mass-produced retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector photometric performance
test_case: Photometric (CIL) measurement of a randomly chosen production retro-reflector at all prescribed points; pass if every value is at least 80 per cent of the prescribed minimum.

text: Mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall comply with the prescribed chromaticity coordinates.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector colour (red)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per UN R150; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed red boundaries.

text: For each type of retro-reflective device, the holder of the approval mark shall carry out at least the conformity tests at appropriate intervals, in accordance with the provisions of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector production conformity control
test_case: Audit of CoP test plan and records; pass if tests are performed at defined intervals for each retro-reflector type per UN R150.

text: If any sampling shows non-conformity with regard to the type of test concerned, further samples shall be taken and tested.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector production conformity control
test_case: Review of CoP records for non-conforming samples; pass if additional samples were taken and tested for each non-conformity.

text: The manufacturer shall take steps to ensure the conformity of the production concerned.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector production
test_case: Audit of corrective action records following non-conformity; pass if documented corrective actions restore conformity.

text: Conformity tests of the retro-reflective device shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics and the resistance to penetration of water.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (photometry, colour, water tightness of the retro-reflector/lamp assembly)
