test_case: Review of CoP test plan; pass if photometric, colorimetric and water penetration tests per UN R150 are included and performed.

text: Conformity tests shall generally be carried out in accordance with the methods set out in this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector CoP testing
test_case: Review of test procedures against UN R150 methods; pass if methods match.

text: Where equivalent methods are used in conformity tests with the consent of the Type Approval Authority, the manufacturer shall prove that the applied methods are equivalent to those laid down in this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector CoP testing
test_case: Review of equivalence evidence (correlation study) and authority consent; pass if equivalence is documented.

text: Test apparatus used for conformity tests shall be regularly calibrated and correlated with measurements made by a Type Approval Authority.
applies_to: Photometric, colorimetric and water penetration test equipment
test_case: Audit of calibration certificates and correlation records; pass if calibration is current and correlation with authority measurements is documented.

text: Samples of retro-reflective devices shall be selected at random from the production of a uniform batch of retro-reflective devices of the same type.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector CoP sampling
test_case: Audit of sampling procedure; pass if samples are drawn randomly from a uniform batch of the same type.

text: The sampled retro-reflective device shall be subjected to photometric measurements at the points and the chromaticity coordinates provided for in the Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector CoP measurements
test_case: Review of test reports; pass if all prescribed photometric points and chromaticity coordinates are measured and recorded.

text: The manufacturer shall carry out a statistical study of the test results and define, in agreement with the Type Approval Authority, acceptability criteria to meet the specifications in paragraph 3.5.1. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector CoP acceptance criteria
test_case: Review of statistical study and agreed acceptance criteria; pass if documented and agreed with the authority.

text: The criteria governing acceptability shall be such that, with a confidence level of 95 per cent, the minimum probability of passing a spot check in accordance with Annex 3 (first sampling) would be 0.95.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector CoP acceptance criteria
test_case: Statistical evaluation of production test data; pass if probability of passing Annex 3 first sampling is at least 0.95 at 95 per cent confidence.

text: Mass-produced rear retro-reflectors shall conform from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint to the requirements of this Regulation, with differences not exceeding inevitable manufacturing deviations.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (integrated in rear combination lamp), housing and optical unit geometry
test_case: Conformity of production check: dimensional/geometric inspection of randomly chosen production samples against the approved type; pass if deviations do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

text: When testing the photometric performance of any mass-produced retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector - photometric performance (CIL values)
test_case: Photometric measurement of a randomly chosen production retro-reflector per this Regulation; retro-reflectors with apparent defects are disregarded; pass if no value is more than 20 per cent below the prescribed minimum.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be complied with.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector - colour of reflected light (red)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples; pass if the chromaticity coordinates lie within the boundaries prescribed for the red retro-reflector colour.

text: In the first sampling of four randomly selected retro-reflective devices (samples A and B), the photometric deviation of every specimen shall not be more than 20 per cent.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector - production photometric conformity
test_case: CoP sampling per Annex 3 paragraph 2: four devices selected at random, marked A (two) and B (two), measured photometrically; pass if no specimen deviates by more than 20 per cent; measurement may be closed if both sample A devices deviate by not more than 0 per cent.

text: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A, after the sampling procedure in paragraph 2., shall pass the resistance to water penetration test according to the procedure described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6; if it fails, both retro-reflective devices of sample B shall pass the same test.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector - sealing / resistance to water penetration (with seal/gasket and housing)
test_case: Water penetration test per Annex 6 Part 2 paragraph 1 on one sample A retro-reflector; pass if test passed; otherwise test both sample B devices, both of which shall pass.

text: When the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 photometry: at β1 = β2 = 0°, turn the device slightly and observe for a mirror effect; the check must be recorded.

text: If a mirror effect is produced at β1 = β2 = 0°, a reading of the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 4 Part 1: if a mirror effect is found, measure RI at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°; that value must meet the paragraph 5 requirement.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', a retro-reflective device which is not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, and this minimum RI must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (not marked TOP)
test_case: Goniometer at β1 = β2 = 0°, α = 20': rotate about the reference axis to find minimum RI; pass if the minimum RI is at least the paragraph 5 value.

text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device not marked "TOP" is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the device shall be placed in the position corresponding to the minimum-RI value of ε; if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (not marked TOP)
test_case: Measure RI at all prescribed β and α at the minimum-RI ε position, with an optional ±5° rotation; pass if all values meet paragraph 5.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', a retro-reflective device marked "TOP" shall be rotated about its axis ±5°, and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (marked TOP)
test_case: Goniometer at β1 = β2 = 0°, α = 20': rotate ±5° about the reference axis from the TOP position; pass if RI is at or above the prescribed value throughout.

text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0° and for ε = 0° the RI of the retro-reflective device exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Check RI at β1 = β2 = 0°, ε = 0°; if it is ≥150 % of the specified value, perform all remaining measurements at ε = 0°.

text: The CIE angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring the retro-reflective device.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Review the test set-up and report; pass if angles are defined per the CIE system in Figure A4-I.

text: For testing the retro-reflection, the retro-reflective device shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Verify the source calibration certificate for CIE Illuminant A; pass if compliant.

text: For the measurement of the retro-reflective device, the angular diameter of the source shall be δ ≤ 10'.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Calculate δ from source size and measuring distance; pass if δ ≤ 10'.

text: For the measurement of the retro-reflective device, the angular diameter of the measuring device shall be γ ≤ 10'.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Calculate γ from receiver size and distance; pass if γ ≤ 10'.

text: For the measurement of the retro-reflective device, the angular diameter of the illuminated area shall be η ≤ 80'.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Calculate η from the retro-reflector visible area and distance; pass if η ≤ 80'.

text: The measuring distance for the retro-reflective device shall be chosen so that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Measure the test distance; pass if it is ≥ 10 m and the δ, γ and η limits are met.

text: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light, shall be sufficiently uniform, with max/min ≤ 1.05 when checked with a measuring element whose sensitive area is not greater than one-tenth of the area examined.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Scan the illuminance over the useful area with a sensor ≤ 1/10 of the area; pass if max/min ≤ 1.05.

text: The photometer head used for measuring the retro-reflective device shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Check the V(λ) correction certificate of the photometer head; pass if compliant.

text: The photometer head shall not show a perceptible change in local sensitivity within the area of its aperture; otherwise suitable provisions shall be added, e.g. a diffusing window at a certain distance in front of the sensitive surface.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Verify the photometer head uniformity, or the presence of a diffuser; pass if there is no perceptible local sensitivity variation.

text: During measurement of the retro-reflective device, the field of view of the photometer head and the spread of light from both the sample and the source shall be restricted as much as possible.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Inspect the set-up for apertures and masking; pass if the field of view and light spread are restricted.

text: Reflections from the floor and walls over the test distance shall be screened from both the retro-reflective device and the photometer head by baffles.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Inspect the test tunnel for baffles; pass if floor and wall reflections are screened.

text: The residual stray light, measured with the retro-reflective device covered by an opaque matt black surface, zigzag folded black paper of the same size and shape, or a suitably oriented specular black surface with a light trap, shall be subtracted from the value measured on the retro-reflective device.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Measure the covered-sample reading and subtract it from each RI reading; pass if the corrected values meet the paragraph 5 requirement.

text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the Class IA or IB retro-reflective device shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape prescribed for retro-reflectors of Classes IIIA and IIIB in paragraph 2.1. of Annex 5, from an observation distance of 10 metres.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (integrated in rear combination lamp, outer lens / retro-reflector illuminating surface)
test_case: Visual inspection per Annex 5, paragraph 3.3: observe the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector from 10 m; pass if the shape is not easily confused with an equilateral triangle as prescribed in Annex 5, paragraph 2.1.

text: In the case of a moulded plastics reflector of a retro-reflecting device of Class IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C for the resistance to heat test.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (moulded plastics optical component)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 1, para. 1: place the retro-reflector sample in a dry oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 consecutive hours. Pass: the exposure is completed and the sample proceeds to cooling and inspection.

text: After the 48-hour heat exposure, the moulded plastics retro-reflective device sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (moulded plastics optical component)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 1, para. 1: after oven exposure, condition the sample for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C before inspection. Pass: the cooling conditions are met and recorded.

text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector, including its optical component
test_case: Visual examination after the Annex 6 Part 1 heat test (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C, then 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C). Pass: no visible cracking and no appreciable distortion of the device or its optical component.

text: For the water penetration test, the retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector (retro-reflector in rear combination lamp, outer lens/housing/seal)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1: remove all removable parts; immerse 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with top of illuminating surface 20 mm below water surface; verify bath temperature, depth and duration are recorded.

text: The 50 °C ± 5 °C immersion test of the retro-reflective device shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector (rear face, housing and seal/gasket)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1: invert device 180°, immerse 10 min at 50 °C ± 5 °C with rear face covered by about 20 mm of water.

text: After the 50 °C immersions, the retro-reflective device sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1: immediately transfer to water at 25 °C ± 5 °C, same orientation/depth/duration conditions (thermal shock).

text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit of the retro-reflector.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector optical unit and its sealing (seal/gasket, outer lens, housing)
test_case: After Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1 immersion sequence, visually inspect the reflecting surface; pass if no water is present.

text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water at the reflecting surface, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector
test_case: Visual inspection after immersion test; any clearly visible water = fail.

text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector photometric performance (RI)
test_case: Lightly shake device to remove external water, then measure RI per para 5.1.3.2.2 of UN R150; compare against required RI values to confirm compliance.

text: As an alternative to the standard water penetration test, at the request of the manufacturer, the retro-reflective device of Class IB or IIIB shall be subjected to the moisture test and the dust test of Annex 6 Part 3.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector (Class IB/IIIB) in the rear combination lamp
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3, paragraphs 2.1 to 2.3.7: moisture (water spray) test followed by dust exposure test; both shall be passed.

text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open, and drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
applies_to: Housing, seal/gasket and drain openings of the rear combination lamp with integrated retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.2.1: inspect the test sample before the test. Pass if no drain hole or opening is sealed and any drain wicks are fitted as in production.

text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray test according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (LED modules on PCB) grouped with the retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.2.3–2.2.4: energise the functions at design voltage, 5 min ON / 55 min OFF, for 12 cycles (12 hours). Spray conditions: solid cone nozzle at 45° ± 5° to vertical, precipitation 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min, device rotated at 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.

text: After the water spray test and a drain period of 1 hour, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, nor be able to be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
applies_to: Housing, outer lens, seal/gasket and retro-reflector cavity
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.2.5–2.2.6: after 12 h spray, stop rotation and spray, drain 1 h with cabinet door closed. Observe interior, then tap and tilt the device. Pass if no standing pool of water is present or formed.

text: After the water spray test, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after drying the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector photometric performance
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.2.6: measure initial RI before the test. After the test, dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth and measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1. Compare with the requirements of the Regulation.

text: During the dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open, and drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
applies_to: Housing and drain openings of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.3.5: inspect the sample before the dust test. Pass if openings are unsealed and drain wicks are present as in production.

text: The device shall resist dust penetration that could significantly affect the photometric output of the retro-reflector when placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall, with the test dust agitated at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
applies_to: Housing, outer lens, seal/gasket and retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.3.2–2.3.6: chamber cubical, 0.9 to 1.5 m per side, max 2 m3, charged with 3 to 5 kg fine powdered cement per ASTM C 150-84. Dust agitated by compressed air or blowers and allowed to settle between periods. Devices longer than 600 mm are horizontally centred.

text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth, and the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector photometric performance
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.3.7: measure initial RI before the dust test. After the test, clean and dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth and measure RI. Pass per the criteria of paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.

text: The retro-reflective device shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (integrated in rear combination lamp)
test_case: Corrosion test per Annex 6 Part 4 and ISO 9227:2017; pass if photometric (RA) and colorimetric characteristics remain within prescribed values after the test.

text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of its rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked, using the corrosion test described in ISO Standard 9227:2017.
applies_to: Retro-reflector front surface and rear face protection; any essential metal components
test_case: Salt spray test per ISO 9227:2017; visual inspection of front surface for tarnishing and rear face protection for deterioration.

text: The lamp combined with the retro-reflective device shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp with integrated retro-reflector (housing, outer lens, retro-reflector)
test_case: Remove all removable parts; saline mist exposure 24 h + 2 h drying + 24 h; sample then assessed per paragraphs 4.1 and 4.2.

text: If the retro-reflective device has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
applies_to: Retro-reflector with essential metal components (e.g. metallised reflective surfaces, metal fasteners)
test_case: Verify salt spray chamber at 35 °C ± 2 °C with 5 % NaCl solution in distilled water with ≤ 0.02 % impurities.

text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp with integrated retro-reflector
test_case: Visual inspection immediately after the 50 h saline mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion impairing device efficiency.

text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector retro-reflective areas
test_case: After 48 h recovery and cleaning of salt deposits, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 value.

text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not more than the value in Table 10.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector retro-reflective areas
test_case: After 48 h recovery and cleaning of salt deposits, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≤ Table 10 value.

text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection after the corrosion test, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector / outer lens surface
test_case: Check test procedure: surface cleaned of salt deposits prior to RA measurement.

text: If the Class IA moulded plastics retro-reflector is mirror-backed with an accessible rear face, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush as the first step of the rear-face resistance test.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (mirror-backed rear face)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 5: brush the mirror-backed reverse side of the retro-reflector sample with a hard nylon brush; confirm the step is done before the solvent exposure.

text: If the Class IA moulded plastics retro-reflector is mirror-backed with an accessible rear face, after brushing, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the rear face of the retro-reflective device for one minute. The cloth is then removed and the device left to dry.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (mirror-backed rear face)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 5 para. 3: after brushing, apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the rear face for 1 min. Remove the cloth and let the device dry. No visible damage to the mirror backing is expected.

text: If the Class IA moulded plastics retro-reflector is mirror-backed with an accessible rear face, the reverse side shall be brushed again with the same brush as before as soon as evaporation of the mixture is completed.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (mirror-backed rear face)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 5 para. 5: once the solvent has fully evaporated, re-brush the reverse side with the same hard nylon brush.

text: If the Class IA moulded plastics retro-reflector is mirror-backed with an accessible rear face, after the brushing and solvent sequence the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face shall be covered with Indian ink, and the RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (mirror-backed rear face)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 5 para. 6: cover the entire mirror-backed rear face with Indian ink, then measure RI per para. 5.1.3.2.2. Pass if the RI meets the criteria of para. 5.1.3.2.2 for Class IA.

text: The resistance to fuels test of the retro-reflective device shall be performed with a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (integrated retro-reflective device)
test_case: Annex 7 Part 1, para. 1: verify test fluid composition is 70 vol.% n-heptane / 30 vol.% toluol before applying to the retro-reflector; pass if the mixture is as specified.

text: For the resistance to fuels test, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector outer surface / illuminating surface
test_case: Annex 7 Part 1, para. 1.1(a): lightly wipe the outer surface, in particular the illuminating surface, of the retro-reflector with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture; pass if the procedure is applied as specified.

text: After about five minutes following the wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes when inspected visually, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector outer surface / illuminating surface
test_case: Annex 7 Part 1, para. 1.1(b): about 5 minutes after wiping with the 70/30 n-heptane/toluol mixture, visually inspect the surface; pass if no apparent surface changes are found (slight surface cracks acceptable).

text: For a moulded plastics retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil, and after about 5 minutes the surface shall be cleaned.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (integrated retro-reflector, outer lens / illuminating surface)
test_case: Annex 7 Part 2, para. 1.1: lightly wipe the outer surface, especially the illuminating surface, with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil, wait about 5 minutes, then clean the surface. Pass: the procedure is applied as specified before the photometric check.

text: After the lubricating oil exposure and cleaning, the coefficient of luminous intensity (RI) of the moulded plastics retro-reflector of Class IA or IB shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (photometric performance after oil resistance test)
test_case: After the Annex 7 Part 2, para. 1.1 oil exposure and cleaning, measure RI according to para. 5.1.3.2.2. of UN R150. Pass: measured RI values meet the requirements referenced in para. 5.1.3.2.2.

text: On the retro-reflective device, the approval number shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
applies_to: Retro-reflector approval marking (housing/lens marking area)
test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark on a production sample against paragraph 3.3. and Annex 10 Figure A10-I: pass if the approval number is adjacent to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

text: On the retro-reflective device, the digits constituting the approval number shall face the same way as the "E".
applies_to: Retro-reflector approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark: pass if all digits of the approval number have the same orientation as the letter "E".

text: On the retro-reflective device, the group of symbols indicating the class shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
applies_to: Retro-reflector approval marking (class symbol, e.g. IA)
test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark: pass if the class symbol group is located on the opposite side of the circle from the approval number.

text: Where the retro-reflector is part of a grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated unit with other lamps, the approval marking shall be arranged in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation, e.g. as in Models D or E of Figure A10-II.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp approval marking (retro-reflector combined with rear position, stop and reversing lamps)
test_case: Visual inspection of the combined approval marking against paragraph 3.3. and Figure A10-II: pass if the retro-reflector approval mark is present and its arrangement conforms.

text: The rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and integrated retro-reflector) shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2., and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the vehicle (housing, fasteners / clips, seal / gasket)
test_case: Inspection of the installed lamp on the M1 vehicle plus vibration exposure representative of normal use (paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1., 2.3.10.2.); pass if the lamp mounting stays secure and photometric, colour and geometric visibility characteristics remain compliant after exposure.

text: The rear combination lamp shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2., and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the vehicle
test_case: Vehicle-level installation check (position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections) before and after representative vibration exposure; pass if all R48 installation requirements for rear position, stop, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector remain met.

text: It shall not be possible for the lamps of the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
applies_to: Mounting interface of the rear combination lamp (housing, fasteners / clips, locating features)
test_case: Design review and physical check of the mounting: attempt to fit and disturb the lamp in normal handling and service; pass if the lamp can only be mounted in the correct orientation and cannot change its aim/position without deliberate use of tools.

text: When the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector functions) is fitted to the vehicle, the reference axis of each light-signalling function shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the vehicle: reference axis of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and the rear retro-reflector, set by the housing and fasteners/clips
test_case: Installation check on the M1 vehicle, unladen and standing on a flat horizontal surface. Measure the angle between each function's reference axis and the road bearing plane, using the manufacturer's reference axis definition. Pass if the deviation from parallel is ≤3° in each direction.

text: When the rear combination lamp is fitted to the vehicle, the reference axis of each signalling function (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector) shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the vehicle: horizontal orientation of the reference axes of all functions relative to the vehicle's longitudinal centre plane
test_case: Installation check on the M1 vehicle. Measure the horizontal angle between each function's reference axis and the vehicle median longitudinal plane, for both the left and right lamps. Pass if the deviation from parallel is ≤3° in each direction.

text: When the rear combination lamp is fitted to the vehicle, any specific instructions on fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp: housing, fasteners/clips and seal/gasket mounting on the vehicle rear
test_case: Review the installed lamp against the manufacturer's fitting instructions, covering mounting orientation, fasteners/clips, seal/gasket seating and connector routing. Pass if every specified instruction is met.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector) shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
applies_to: Installation on the M1 vehicle: mounting height and orientation of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector
test_case: Place the vehicle unladen on a flat, horizontal surface in the condition of paras 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. Measure each function's mounting height and orientation. Pass if the measured values meet the installation requirements for each function.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this estimate being based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.
applies_to: Installation of left and right rear combination lamps (housing / outer lens exterior form) on the M1 vehicle rear
test_case: Measure the installed left and right lamps on the vehicle (e.g. CMM or vehicle drawing check) relative to the median longitudinal plane using the exterior geometrical form of each lamp; pass if the positions are mirror-symmetrical within measurement tolerance.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the left and right rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
applies_to: Exterior design of left- and right-hand rear combination lamps (outer lens, housing, retro-reflector)
test_case: Compare left and right lamp exterior geometry (CAD and physical samples); pass if the exterior form is mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane; differences in interior structure (LED modules, PCB, reflector) are disregarded.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps of each function constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
applies_to: Light colour of rear position, stop and reversing functions and retro-reflector colour (outer lens, LED light sources) on left and right lamps
test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of each function on the left and right lamp per the applicable device regulation; pass if both lamps of the pair meet the same prescribed colour (red for rear position, stop and retro-reflector; white for reversing).

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps of each function constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except where the lamps form a matched pair of a function.
applies_to: Photometric performance of rear position, stop, reversing and retro-reflector functions on left and right lamps
test_case: Perform goniophotometric measurement of each function on left and right lamps at the prescribed test points; pass if the light distributions/intensity values (or CIL values for retro-reflectors) are substantially identical, or, for a matched pair, the pair as a whole complies with the photometric requirements.

text: If the rear combination lamps incorporate a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Manufacturer logo in the outer lens / illuminating surface of the rear combination lamps, if any
test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear with all lamps; pass if no logo is present, or there are at most two lateral logos (one per side) or one central logo in total on the rear.

text: If the rear combination lamps incorporate a logo, any logo that is not a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo is prohibited.
applies_to: Logo graphics in the outer lens / lamp of the rear combination lamps, if any
test_case: Visual inspection of lamp graphics against design documents; pass if any logo present is exclusively a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.

text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the installation requirements of the preceding paragraphs for the pair of rear combination lamps (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
applies_to: Installation of the left and right rear combination lamps (rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector functions) on M1 vehicles with asymmetrical external shape
test_case: Vehicle installation review: if the vehicle's external shape is asymmetrical, check the positions and orientations of the left and right lamps against the preceding installation requirements (e.g. paired-lamp symmetry about the median longitudinal plane, equal height). Pass if every deviation is documented and justified solely by the vehicle's asymmetrical shape.

text: When the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled for each function.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (all functions: rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector)
test_case: Design review and installation check on the M1 vehicle against the individual function requirements of UN R48 for colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connections. Pass if every function complies while grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated.

text: The photometric requirements of each lamp function of the rear combination lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions (LED modules, outer lens)
test_case: Photometric measurement of each function separately, with all other functions of the lamp switched OFF. Pass if the intensities meet the applicable photometric requirements.

text: The colorimetric requirements of each lamp function of the rear combination lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions; outer lens colour
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of each function separately, with all other functions switched OFF. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed colour boundaries (red for rear position and stop, white for reversing).

text: When the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it (e.g. the stop lamp), the colour requirements of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON.
applies_to: Rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp (and any other simultaneously operable function)
test_case: Switch the rear position lamp and the reciprocally incorporated function ON together, then measure the chromaticity of the other function. Pass if it lies within its prescribed colour boundaries.

text: If a lamp function of the rear combination lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, then either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis, shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions with segmented apparent surfaces (LED modules, outer lens); not applicable to the retro-reflector
test_case: Project the apparent surface parts along the reference axis onto a plane tangent to the outer lens, using CAD or measurement. Pass if the projected area is ≥ 60 % of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or if the facing-edge gap is ≤ 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

text: If a single lamp function as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), is composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, then either the projection of the apparent surfaces of the two lamps or retro reflectors in the direction of the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing those projections, or the minimum distance between their facing edges in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
applies_to: Rear lamp functions realised as two "D"-marked lamps, or retro-reflector realised as two independent retro reflectors
test_case: Geometric check of the projected apparent surfaces along the reference axis. Pass if the projected area is ≥ 60 % of the circumscribing quadrilateral, or if the facing-edge distance is ≤ 75 mm.

text: If a lamp function of the rear combination lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), it shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp or reversing lamp realised as an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Apply the paragraph 5.7.2.1 projection check (≥ 60 % area or ≤ 75 mm gap) to the interdependent lamp system. Pass if either criterion is met.

text: The maximum height above the ground of the rear combination lamp functions (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector) shall be measured from the highest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
applies_to: Installation on vehicle: rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector (mounting height)
test_case: Vehicle on substantially horizontal ground; measure the vertical distance from the ground to the highest point of each function's apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis. Pass: the value is determined this way and complies with the maximum height prescribed for each function. Exact edges need not be determined where compliance is clear.

text: The minimum height above the ground of the rear combination lamp functions (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector) shall be measured from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
applies_to: Installation on vehicle: rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector (mounting height)
test_case: Vehicle on substantially horizontal ground; measure the vertical distance from the ground to the lowest point of each function's apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis. Pass: the value is determined this way and complies with the minimum height prescribed for each function. Exact edges need not be determined where compliance is clear.

text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of the lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
applies_to: Installation on vehicle: geometric visibility of rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector
test_case: Where a reduced vertical geometric visibility angle is claimed based on mounting height, measure the height from the ground to the H plane (horizontal plane through the centre of reference). Pass: the height used to justify the reduced angle is the H plane height.

text: The position of the lamp as regards width, when referred to the overall width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
applies_to: Installation on vehicle: lateral position of rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector relative to overall width
test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost edge of each function's apparent surface (in the direction of the reference axis) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle's overall width. Pass: distance determined from that edge and complies with the prescribed limit. Exact edges need not be determined where compliance is clear.

text: The position of the lamps as regards width, when referred to the distance between lamps, shall be determined from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
applies_to: Installation on vehicle: distance between left and right rear combination lamps (rear position lamps, stop lamps, rear retro-reflectors)
test_case: Measure the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces (in the direction of the reference axis) of the left and right lamps of the same function. Pass: distance determined from the inner edges and complies with the prescribed minimum separation. Exact edges need not be determined where compliance is clear.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (LED modules on PCB, outer lens)
test_case: Switch the rear position lamp ON at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over time (photometer/colorimeter, visual check); pass if no intentional variation occurs while switched ON other than permitted under 5.9.2.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the stop lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (LED array on PCB, outer lens)
test_case: Activate the stop lamp at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over time; pass if no intentional variation (e.g. dimming, animation, flashing) occurs while switched ON other than permitted under 5.9.2.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (LED modules on PCB, outer lens)
test_case: Activate the reversing lamp at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over time; pass if no intentional variation occurs while switched ON other than permitted under 5.9.2.

text: If the stop lamp is used to provide the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall be a flashing lamp.
applies_to: Stop lamp function when operated as emergency stop signal
test_case: Trigger the emergency stop signal on the vehicle and observe the stop lamp; pass if the stop lamp operates in flashing mode.

text: Where the photometric characteristics of the lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (LED driver/PCB control)
test_case: Measure photometry and colour in each variation state (e.g. day/night ambient level, position lamp ON with stop lamp ON/OFF, combined functions); pass if every state meets the photometric and colorimetric requirements of the applicable device regulation for that function.

text: If the lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the lamp shall operate according to the conditions specified in the general specifications and/or in paragraph 6.27.
applies_to: Rear position lamp / stop lamp functions if used for answer-back signal
test_case: Activate the answer-back signal with the vehicle in park condition and verify operation (flashing, intensity, apparent surface variation, activation conditions) against the general specifications and paragraph 6.27; pass if all conditions are met.

text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector (red functions) as installed at the vehicle rear; outer lens and housing
test_case: Vehicle-level visibility check per paragraph 5.10.4.1 (Zone 1, transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle, Annex 4); pass if no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
applies_to: Apparent surfaces of the red rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector as installed on the M1 vehicle rear corners
test_case: Observer moves within Zone 1 of Annex 4 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

text: In case of doubt, the requirement of no direct visibility of red light towards the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
applies_to: Red rear position lamp and stop lamp functions (LED modules, reflector, outer lens, housing) as installed on the vehicle
test_case: Photometric measurement of red light emitted towards the front (Zone 1 directions), from lamp type-approval data, including vehicle body influence if applicable; pass if ≤ 0.25 cd per lamp.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp, except while the front and rear position lamps are switched ON as parking lamps, daytime running lamps are switched ON, or the front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function – electrical connection / vehicle wiring harness connector
test_case: Vehicle-level functional check of the lighting switch: operate the position lamp switch ON and OFF and verify that the rear position lamps (left and right) switch ON and OFF together with the front position lamps, the end-outline and side-marker lamps (if fitted) and the rear registration plate lamp. Verify that the exemptions in 5.11.1 (parking lamp mode, DRL ON, 5.12.1 substitution) are the only cases of non-simultaneous operation. Pass: no switching state in which the rear position lamps can be ON or OFF independently outside those exemptions.

text: If the rear position lamp, stop lamp or reversing lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of that system shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB of an interdependent lamp system (rear position, stop or reversing lamp function)
test_case: Functional check on vehicle: activate and deactivate each function provided by an interdependent lamp system and observe all LED light sources of all interdependent lamps. Pass: all light sources switch ON and OFF at the same time, with no source remaining ON or OFF independently.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (LED modules, outer lens)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the rear position lamp function with the lamp energised as installed; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the red chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (LED array, outer lens)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the stop lamp function with the lamp energised; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the red chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (LED modules, outer lens)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the reversing lamp function with the lamp energised; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the white chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

text: The colour of the light reflected by the non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall be red.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector (non-triangular)
test_case: Illuminate the retro-reflector with a standard illuminant and measure the chromaticity of the reflected light; pass if the coordinates (x,y) lie within the red chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

text: The number of lamps (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on M1 vehicle (rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector functions)
test_case: Visual inspection of the vehicle installation: count the installed rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors and compare with the numbers given in the individual specifications of UN R48 (paragraph 6). Pass if the count for each function equals the prescribed number.

text: If the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp or rear retro-reflector) is installed on movable components of the vehicle (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. shall be fulfilled.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the vehicle (all functions and the integrated retro-reflector), where mounted on a movable component
test_case: Review the vehicle installation drawings to determine whether any lamp function or the retro-reflector is mounted on a movable component. If so, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. by inspection and photometric/geometric checks in the relevant positions of the movable component. Pass if every condition of 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. is met; not applicable if the lamp is mounted only on fixed body parts.

text: If the rear position lamp is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), the rear position lamp shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (installation on movable component)
test_case: Installation check on the vehicle with the movable component in each fixed position (closed and each fixed open position): verify mounting position, geometric visibility angles, colour and photometric values per R48 rear position lamp provisions; pass if all are met in every fixed position.

text: If the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the rear retro-reflector shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear retro-reflectors at all fixed positions of the movable component.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector (installation on movable component)
test_case: Installation check on the vehicle with the movable component in each fixed position: verify position, geometric visibility, colour and photometric (CIL) requirements for rear retro-reflectors; pass if all are met in every fixed position.

text: Where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector function is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.) installed on a movable component, at least one of the lamps shall meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component.
applies_to: Rear position lamp / rear retro-reflector provided as "D"-marked lamp pair on movable component
test_case: Vehicle check in each fixed position of the movable component: verify that at least one of the two "D" lamps meets position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements; pass if satisfied in all fixed positions.

text: Where additional lamps for the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
applies_to: Additional rear position lamps / retro-reflectors on fixed body used when movable component is open
test_case: With movable component in each fixed open position, verify additional lamps are switched ON and meet position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements of the lamps on the movable component; pass if all met.

text: Where the rear position lamp function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system completely mounted on the movable component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied, unless additional lamps for the function are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position and these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
applies_to: Rear position lamp realised as interdependent lamp system fully on movable component
test_case: Vehicle check in all fixed positions of the movable component: verify either compliance per 5.18.1 or that additional lamps switched ON in open positions meet position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements.

text: Where the rear position lamp function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
applies_to: Rear position lamp realised as interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components
test_case: Vehicle check in all fixed positions of the movable component: verify the Applicant-specified interdependent lamp(s) meet position, outwards geometric visibility, colour and photometric requirements; pass if met in all positions.

text: Where the rear position lamp interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the inwards geometric visibility requirement is deemed satisfied only if the Applicant-specified interdependent lamp(s) still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
applies_to: Rear position lamp interdependent lamp system (inwards geometric visibility)
test_case: Photometric measurement of the specified interdependent lamp(s) over the device-approval light distribution field with movable component in each fixed position; pass if all prescribed photometric values are met.

text: If the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and retro-reflector) is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), then when that component is in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on it shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on movable components (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: place the movable component (e.g. tailgate open) in each position other than the normal position of use with the lamp functions activated. Check light directions and visibility from relevant road-user positions. Pass if no glare or misleading or disturbing signal causes undue discomfort to road users.

text: When the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector) is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid) and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on vehicle (housing, fasteners/clips) when mounted on a movable component
test_case: If any part of the lamp is mounted on a movable body component: operate the movable component repeatedly (e.g. open/close 10 times) and return it to the normal position of use. After each cycle, verify the lamp position and orientation relative to the vehicle against the manufacturer-specified installation position (height, width, angles of geometric visibility per R48 paragraph 6). Pass if the lamp returns each time to the specified position and all installation requirements remain met.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
applies_to: Rear position lamp function, installation on the vehicle rear relative to movable components (e.g. tailgate, boot lid)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position other than the normal position of use, locked or unlocked. Measure the projected apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of its reference axis. Pass if no more than 50 % of it is hidden.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector, installation on the vehicle rear relative to movable components
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position other than the normal position of use. Measure the apparent surface of the retro-reflector in the direction of its reference axis. Pass if no more than 50 % of it is hidden.

text: If the 50 per cent limit of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable for the rear position lamp, additional lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component. These additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function / vehicle lighting control (additional rear position lamps and switching logic)
test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: move the component to each position that hides more than 50 % of the rear position lamp's apparent surface. Pass if the additional lamps switch ON automatically. Verify that the additional lamps meet the R48 position and geometric visibility requirements and the colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps.

text: If neither paragraph 5.21. nor paragraph 5.21.1. is applied for the rear position lamp, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function, vehicle user notice
test_case: Vehicle inspection: check that a notice is present in the vehicle. Pass if it states the positions of the movable components in which other road users must be warned, e.g. by a warning triangle.

text: For the rear retro-reflector, the alternative of paragraph 5.21.2. (communication form remark and user notice) shall not be used. The retro-reflector shall therefore comply with paragraph 5.21. or paragraph 5.21.1.
applies_to: Integrated rear retro-reflector, installation on vehicle
test_case: Design and installation review: confirm that compliance of the retro-reflector with paragraph 5.21. is not claimed by means of a 5.21.2 notice. Pass if the retro-reflector meets the 50 % hiding limit, or if the alternative of 5.21.1 is provided.

text: With the exception of the retro-reflector, each lamp function of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp), even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; therefore each lamp function shall be capable of being made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions (LED modules on PCB, connector, vehicle wiring) as installed on the M1 vehicle
test_case: Inspection on the vehicle: with the lamp installed and connected to the vehicle harness, verify that each of the rear position, stop and reversing functions operates when only the light source(s) and/or fuse(s) are fitted, with no further wiring, programming or modification required. Pass: every function operates.

text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (fail-safe replacement function, if implemented)
test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp LEDs; measure colour of the replacement function and compare with the rear position lamp (red) colour coordinates; pass if similar/within red colour limits.

text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in main intensity to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (fail-safe replacement function, if implemented)
test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure; photometric measurement of the replacement function at main test points (H-V); pass if intensity is similar to that of the original rear position lamp.

text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in position to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (fail-safe replacement function, if implemented); installation on vehicle rear
test_case: Inspect installation/drawings: verify the replacement light-emitting surface is located similarly to the original rear position lamp (height, width, lateral position).

text: If a device is used as temporary fail-safe replacement for the rear position lamp, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
applies_to: Replacement device (e.g. stop lamp function) within the rear combination lamp
test_case: With rear position lamp failure simulated and replacement active, activate the original function of the replacement device (e.g. stop signal); pass if it still operates and meets its photometric requirements.

text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
applies_to: Vehicle tell-tale / failure detection of rear position lamp
test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure on vehicle; pass if dashboard tell-tale activates for the duration of the replacement.

text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, their luminous intensities, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2) with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Photometric measurement of the R2 and S2 functions at several intensity control steps under each triggering condition; pass if both functions change simultaneously, in the same direction and in a similar proportion.

text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained in the entire intensity range and throughout variation transitions.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2) with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Continuous photometric recording of both functions during intensity transitions across the full control range; pass if the stop/position lamp intensity ratio prescribed by the pertinent UN Regulation is maintained at all times.

text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, increases and decreases of luminous intensity in relation to environmental conditions shall respond only to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light emitting surface, and shall remain within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
applies_to: Variable intensity control of rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2)
test_case: Review of control strategy and photometric measurement at maximum and minimum control levels; pass if triggers are limited to the listed conditions and all intensities remain within the minimum/maximum values of the pertinent UN Regulation (e.g. UN R7).

text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, a decrease of the luminous intensity in relation to traffic conditions shall only be activated as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m, and shall remain within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
applies_to: Variable intensity control of rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2)
test_case: Vehicle/HIL test varying speed and following distance; pass if intensity decrease is activated only at speed ≤ 20 km/h or following distance ≤ 20 m and reduced intensity stays within the pertinent UN Regulation limits.

text: If a traffic-condition intensity decrease of the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 has been activated, it may remain active only as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h.
applies_to: Variable intensity control of rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2)
test_case: Vehicle/HIL test: activate decrease, then accelerate; pass if the decrease is cancelled when vehicle speed exceeds 50 km/h.

text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2) with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Time-resolved photometric recording and visual observation during intensity transitions; pass if intensity changes progressively without visible steps or abrupt jumps.

text: When the electrical system of the M1 vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the vehicle category as specified by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions), where according to its type approval documentation it has been tested with a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant device or function as approved. Per paragraph 5.27.3, this does not apply if the lamp includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light sources approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electrical supply at terminals / connector (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions) as installed on the vehicle
test_case: Vehicle-level demonstration to the Technical Service. Run the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage operating condition and measure the voltage at the lamp connector terminals for each function. Pass if the measured voltage is at or below the voltage stated in the lamp's type approval documentation. Not applicable if a 5.27.3 exemption applies.

text: In all electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1, when the vehicle electrical system is in a representative constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent in 6 Volt-Systems. This does not apply where a paragraph 5.27.3 exemption applies.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp terminals / connector (6 V systems)
test_case: Measure the terminal voltage of each function with the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage condition. Pass if the voltage is ≤ 6.75 V × 1.03 (6.95 V).

text: In all electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1, when the vehicle electrical system is in a representative constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 13.5 V by more than 3 per cent in 12 Volt-Systems. This does not apply where a paragraph 5.27.3 exemption applies.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp terminals / connector (12 V systems)
test_case: Measure the terminal voltage of the rear position, stop and reversing functions with the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage condition. Pass if the voltage is ≤ 13.5 V × 1.03 (13.905 V).

text: In all electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1, when the vehicle electrical system is in a representative constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 28 V by more than 3 per cent in 24 Volt-Systems. This does not apply where a paragraph 5.27.3 exemption applies.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp terminals / connector (24 V systems)
test_case: Measure the terminal voltage of each function with the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage condition. Pass if the voltage is ≤ 28 V × 1.03 (28.84 V).

text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector) observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as installed on the vehicle: rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector apparent surfaces; outer lens and surrounding vehicle body parts
test_case: Installation check on the M1 vehicle: observe the apparent surface of each function from infinity (or with parallel-shifted observation directions) across the full prescribed angles of geometric visibility.
