Pass if no vehicle part obstructs light propagation from any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

text: If geometric visibility measurements are taken closer to the lamp than infinity, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
applies_to: Geometric visibility verification of the installed rear combination lamp functions
test_case: Review of the measurement setup: confirm that near-field observations use observation directions shifted parallel to the nominal directions at infinity. Pass if the near-field results match the accuracy of observation from infinity.

text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector functions as installed, where vehicle parts partially mask the apparent surface
test_case: Photometric measurement of each partially hidden function with the vehicle masking reproduced, either on the vehicle or with a masking fixture. Pass if all prescribed photometric values for device approval are met by the unhidden part across the required field.

text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
applies_to: Installed rear combination lamp functions mounted with the relevant edge less than 750 mm above the ground
test_case: Measure the mounting height according to paragraph 5.8.1. If it is less than 750 mm and the function permits a reduced downward visibility angle, verify geometric visibility and photometry of the installed optical unit down to 5° below the horizontal. Pass if requirements are met within the reduced field.

text: The LED modules of the rear combination lamp do not need to be replaceable, provided this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval; otherwise the LED modules shall be replaceable.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (rear position, stop and reversing lamp light sources)
test_case: Document review and inspection: check the component type approval communication sheet. If it states the LED module is non-replaceable, the design passes. If it does not, verify on the sample that the LED module can be removed and replaced.

text: When installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp function of the rear combination lamp shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation (UN Regulation No. 148), as specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function
test_case: Documentary check: verify a valid UN R148 type approval and approval marking for the rear position lamp function on the installed lamp; pass if present and matching the installed device.

text: When installed on the vehicle, the stop lamp function of the rear combination lamp shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation (UN Regulation No. 148), as specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48.
applies_to: Stop lamp function
test_case: Documentary check: verify a valid UN R148 type approval and approval marking for the stop lamp function on the installed lamp; pass if present and matching the installed device.

text: When installed on the vehicle, the reversing lamp function of the rear combination lamp shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation (UN Regulation No. 148), as specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function
test_case: Documentary check: verify a valid UN R148 type approval and approval marking for the reversing lamp function on the installed lamp; pass if present and matching the installed device.

text: When installed on the vehicle, the integrated rear retro-reflector shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation (UN Regulation No. 150), as specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Documentary check: verify a valid UN R150 type approval and approval marking for the rear retro-reflector on the installed device; pass if present and matching the installed device.

text: If the rear combination lamp (light-signalling lamp) incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp light-signalling functions incorporating a manufacturer logo (outer lens / light-emitting surface)
test_case: Design review for presence of a manufacturer logo; if present, verify the UN R148 type approval covers the lamp including the logo; pass if approval documentation and marking include the logo variant.

text: A reversing lamp shall be present on the motor vehicle (mandatory on motor vehicles).
applies_to: Reversing lamp function – installation on M1 vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that at least one reversing lamp is fitted. Pass if a reversing lamp is present.

text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device is optional.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function – number of devices on M1 vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: count reversing lamp devices. Pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function of rear combination lamp
test_case: Document and marking check: verify a valid approval mark and certificate to UN R23 (00 or later series) or UN R148 (00 or later series) for the reversing lamp function. Pass if present.

text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – mounting height on vehicle
test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground with vehicle in reference condition on horizontal ground. Pass if lowest edge ≥ 250 mm and highest edge ≤ 1,200 mm.

text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – longitudinal position on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reversing lamp is installed at the rear of the vehicle. Pass if rear-mounted.

text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angle α, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – geometric visibility (vertical)
test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. on installed lamp: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface from 15° up to 5° down. Pass if visibility achieved over the full range.

text: If there is only one reversing lamp device installed at the rear, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° to right and to left.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – geometric visibility (horizontal), single device
test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7.: verify visibility from 45° left to 45° right. Pass if visibility achieved over the full range.

text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – geometric visibility (horizontal), left and right devices
test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. on each installed lamp: verify visibility from 45° outboard to 30° inboard. Pass if visibility achieved over the full range for each lamp.

text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – orientation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection/measurement of reference axis: verify reversing lamp reference axis points rearwards. Pass if oriented rearwards.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – electrical connection / vehicle wiring and control
test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse with propulsion system operable – lamp ON; check lamp cannot be switched ON in any other gear/ignition combination. Pass if lamp ON only when both conditions are met.

text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – electrical connection / vehicle wiring and control
test_case: Functional test on vehicle: with lamp ON, disengage reverse gear, then separately switch propulsion system off. Pass if lamp switches OFF immediately in each case and does not switch ON when either condition is not met.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation; otherwise a tell-tale is optional.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – failure tell-tale / LED module electronics
test_case: Check UN R23/R148 approval for failure tell-tale requirement; if required, simulate LED failure and verify tell-tale activation. Pass if tell-tale indicates failure where required.

text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be installed (mandatory on all categories of vehicles, including M1).
applies_to: Stop lamp function (S1/S2 category devices in the rear combination lamps)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are present on the M1 vehicle; pass if fitted.

text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (left and right rear combination lamps)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count the S1/S2 stop lamps fitted at the rear; pass if exactly two (one in each left/right rear combination lamp).

text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Stop lamp function; lamp markings / approval
test_case: Document and marking check: verify a UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later) approval and the corresponding approval marking with S1 or S2 category on the lamp; pass if present and valid.

text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of each S1 or S2 category stop lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp function; lamp installation position in width
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface (in the reference axis direction) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, left and right; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
applies_to: Stop lamp function; lamp installation height
test_case: Measure on the unladen vehicle the height of the lower and upper edges of the stop lamp apparent surface above ground according to paragraph 5.8.1; pass if lowest point ≥ 350 mm and highest point ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork shape justifies it).

text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp function; lamp installation position in length
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if so.

text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; however, for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Stop lamp function; geometric visibility as installed (outer lens, housing, surrounding bodywork)
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° outward and 45° inward (or 20° inward below H plane if mounted below 750 mm per 5.8.1); pass if the apparent surface is visible throughout the required field.

text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Stop lamp function; geometric visibility as installed
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface 15° upward and 15° downward (or 5° downward if mounted below 750 mm per 5.8.1); pass if visible throughout the required field.

text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp function; lamp orientation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the reference axis of the stop lamp points rearward parallel to the vehicle longitudinal axis; pass if oriented towards the rear.

text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
applies_to: Stop lamp function; electrical connection / LED modules and connector
test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: apply the service brake (and other braking signals defined in R13/R13-H); pass if all stop lamps (left, right and centre high-mounted) illuminate simultaneously.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamps shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
applies_to: Stop lamp function; LED light source failure detection / electrical interface
test_case: Check the component regulation (UN R7/R148) requirements for the approved LED stop lamp; if failure tell-tale required, simulate LED failure and verify the tell-tale activates; pass if it does (or if not required).

text: Rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 shall be mandatory on the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (vehicle installation)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted; pass if present.

text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (left and right rear combination lamps)
test_case: Check the vehicle has exactly two rear position lamps and that each bears a valid approval mark to UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later); pass if both conditions are met.

text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp installation position (width)
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface (reference axis direction) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
applies_to: Rear position lamp installation position (height)
test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground per paragraph 5.8.1 with the vehicle on a substantially horizontal surface; pass if lowest point ≥ 350 mm and highest point ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justification applies and no optional lamps are fitted).

text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp installation position (length)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if so.

text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp geometric visibility (horizontal)
test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle or CAD: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° inwards to 80° outwards (20° inwards below H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Rear position lamp geometric visibility (vertical)
test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

text: For M1 vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards (inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane where mounted below 750 mm) and a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal (downward angle may be reduced to 5° where mounted below 750 mm).
applies_to: Rear position lamp geometric visibility (alternative, with rear side-marker lamp)
test_case: If the alternative is chosen, confirm rear side-marker lamp fitted and verify visibility over 45° out/45° in and ±15° vertical (with reductions per mounting height); pass if visible throughout.

text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
applies_to: Rear position lamp apparent surface / integrated retro-reflector
test_case: Determine the projected unobstructed apparent surface at the visibility angle limits excluding the non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm² in each direction.

text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
applies_to: Rear position lamp orientation
test_case: Verify the lamp reference axis points rearwards when installed; pass if so.

text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear position lamps and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
applies_to: Rear position lamp tell-tale (vehicle)
test_case: Switch on position lamps and check a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates, shared with the front position lamps; pass if present and combined.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp failure tell-tale (LED modules)
test_case: Review component approval (R7/R148); if failure indication required, simulate LED failure and verify failure tell-tale activates; pass if it does.

text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be present on the motor vehicle (mandatory on motor vehicles).
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (vehicle installation)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are fitted on the M1 vehicle. Pass if present.

text: Two rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be fitted to the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (vehicle installation, left and right rear combination lamps)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the mandatory rear retro-reflectors. Pass if exactly two are fitted as mandatory devices.

text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
applies_to: Integrated retro-reflector
test_case: Document and marking check: verify the retro-reflector approval mark and certificate show Class IA or IB to UN R3 02 series or later, or UN R150 00 series or later. Pass if a valid approval is present.

text: Any additional retro-reflecting devices and materials, including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4., shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
applies_to: Additional retro-reflecting devices/materials on the rear lamp
test_case: Vehicle inspection: if additional retro-reflecting devices or materials are fitted, assess their effect on the mandatory lamps. Pass if the effectiveness of the mandatory devices is not impaired.

text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
applies_to: Retro-reflector position on vehicle (width)
test_case: Vehicle measurement: measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, on each side. Pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
applies_to: Retro-reflector position on vehicle (height)
test_case: Vehicle measurement per paragraph 5.8.1 with the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground: measure the lowest edge of the illuminating surface. Pass if ≥ 250 mm.

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
applies_to: Retro-reflector position on vehicle (height)
test_case: Vehicle measurement per paragraph 5.8.1: measure the highest edge of the illuminating surface. Pass if ≤ 900 mm, or ≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with the rear lamps (applies to this rear combination lamp), or ≤ 1,500 mm where the bodywork shape prevents compliance.

text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Retro-reflector position on vehicle (length)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle. Pass if it is located at the rear.

text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 30° inwards and 30° outwards.
applies_to: Retro-reflector geometric visibility
test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle or CAD: verify an unobstructed illuminating surface view at 30° inwards and 30° outwards. Pass if visible over the full horizontal range.

text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above the horizontal.
applies_to: Retro-reflector geometric visibility
test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify an unobstructed view at 10° upward. Pass if visible.

text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° below the horizontal; where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Retro-reflector geometric visibility
test_case: Measure the mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1, then verify an unobstructed view at 10° downward (or 5° if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if visible over the applicable angle.

text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
applies_to: Retro-reflector orientation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that the reference axis of the retro-reflector faces rearwards. Pass if oriented rearwards.

text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. of UN R48, including the installation of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector).
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the M1 vehicle (conformity of production)
test_case: Conformity of production check: inspect production vehicles and compare the installed rear combination lamp (number, position, geometric visibility, orientation, electrical connections, tell-tales) against the approved type and the requirements of paragraphs 5. and 6. of UN R48. Pass if no deviation from the approved type and all requirements of paragraphs 5. and 6. are met.

text: The position of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the rear retro-reflector, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on M1 vehicle (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector)
test_case: Conformity of production check on the vehicle: measure lamp position in width, height and length per paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; pass if the measured positions meet these requirements.

text: The values measured for the distances of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the rear retro-reflector shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on M1 vehicle (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector)
test_case: Compare the measured width, height and length distances with the individual installation specifications for each function; pass if all individual specifications are fulfilled.

text: The angles of geometric visibility of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the rear retro-reflector shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation, and the values measured shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on M1 vehicle (geometric visibility of each function, incl. reversing lamp 45° outboard)
test_case: Measure angles of geometric visibility per paragraph 2.10.7.; pass if each function meets its individual specified angles, with a tolerance of ±3º on the angle limits.

text: The visibility of red light from the rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector towards the front of the vehicle shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector (red light) installed on vehicle
test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10. that red light is not directly visible towards the front within the prescribed zone; pass if paragraph 5.10. is fulfilled.

text: The visibility of white light towards the rear of the vehicle shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation (reversing lamp and outer lens light transmission)
test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10. that no white light other than that permitted (e.g. reversing lamp) is visible towards the rear; pass if paragraph 5.10. is fulfilled.

text: The electrical connections of the rear combination lamp shall be checked by switching on every lamp function supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
applies_to: Electrical connector and LED modules of rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: On the vehicle, switch on each function (rear position, stop, reversing) via the vehicle electrical system; pass if each function lights.

text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp and any associated tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp functions and associated tell-tales
test_case: Functional check of switching and electrical connection per paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and individual lamp specifications; pass if all provisions are met.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings and shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (all functions, outer lens colour and approval markings) as installed on vehicle
test_case: Visual inspection of installed lamps and their markings; pass if presence, number, colour, arrangement and category comply with paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and the individual specifications.

text: When verifying that no red light from the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, red retro-reflector) is visible to the front of the vehicle (see paragraph 5.10.4.), zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector (red light); outer lens and housing as installed on the M1 vehicle
test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground. Observe the lamp from the front within zone 1, between heights of 1 m and 2.2 m above ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp is directly visible to an observer within this zone.

text: When verifying that no red light from the rear combination lamp is visible to the front of the vehicle, zone 1 shall be bounded in width by a vertical plane forming to the front an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane and passing through the point of contact of the vertical plane parallel to the median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector (red light); lamp outboard position on the vehicle
test_case: Geometric check on the vehicle. Construct the 15° outward forward plane through the foremost point of contact of the overall-width plane. Observe from all positions in zone 1 between 1 m and 2.2 m above ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp is directly visible.
